word_meanings: मन्त्रिपते O Foremost of counsellors, शीघ्रम् speedily, गच्छ go, अमितप्रभम् immeasurable splendour, ऐक्ष्वाकुम् Ikshvaku king Dasaratha, दुर्धर्षम् invincible, समन्त्रिणम् together with ministers, आत्मजै: along with sons, समानयस्व bring him.

text: औपकार्यां स गत्वा तु रघूणां कुलवर्धनम् ददर्श शिरसा चैनमभिवाद्येदमब्रवीत् ॥१-७०-१२॥
translation: Having reached the tent, he (Sudamana) saw Dasaratha, perpetuator of the race of the Raghus and bowing down his head, said:
word_meanings: स: he, औपकार्याम् tent, गत्वा having gone, रघूणाम् of the race of Raghus, कुलवर्धनम् perpetuating, ददर्श saw, एनम् him, शिरसा bowing down his head, अभिवाद्य having saluted him, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: अयोध्याधिपते वीर वैदेहो मिथिलाधिप: स त्वां द्रष्टुं व्यवसितस्सोपाध्यायपुरोहितम् ॥१-७०-१३॥
translation: "O Heroic lord of Ayodhya, Janaka, the lord of Mithila desires to see you along with preceptors and priest".
word_meanings: वीर O Heroic one, अयोध्याधिपते O Lord of Ayodhya, मिथिलाधिप: lord of Mithila, वैदेह: Janaka, सोपाध्यायपुरोहितम् along with spiritual preceptors and chief priest, त्वाम् you, द्रष्टुम् to see, सः he, व्यवसित: has decided.

text: मंत्रिश्रेष्ठवच श्शृत्वा राजा सर्षिगणस्तदा सबंधुरगमत्तत्र जनको यत्र वर्तते ॥१-७०-१४॥
translation: King Dasaratha on hearing the words of the best of the counsellors reached the place where Janaka was waiting with hosts of rishis and relations.
word_meanings: तदा then, राजा king, मंत्रिश्रेष्ठवच: the words of the best of counsellors, श्रुत्वा having listened, सर्षिगण: with hosts of rishis, सबंधु: with relations, जनक: Janaka, यत्र where, वर्तते was waiting, तत्र there, अगमत् went.

text: स राजा मन्त्रिसहित स्सोपाध्याय: सबान्धव: वाक्यं वाक्यविदां श्रेष्ठो वैदेहमिदमब्रवीत् ॥१-७०-१५॥
translation: The king (Dasaratha), skilled in speech, accompanied by counsellors and kins said to Janaka,the lord of the Videhas:
word_meanings: मन्त्रिसहित: along with counsellors, सबान्धव: with relations, स: king Dasaratha, वाक्यविदाम् among those skilled speech, श्रेष्ठ: excellent, राजा king, वैदेहम् addressing, इदम् these, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: विदितं ते महाराज इक्ष्वाकुकुलदैवतम् वक्ता सर्वेषु कृत्येषु वसिष्ठो भगवानृषि: ॥१-७०-१६॥
translation: "O Great king venerable Vasishta is the spiritual protector of the Ikshvakus race and it is known that for all ceremonies he is our spokesman".
word_meanings: महाराज O Great king, भगवान् venerable, वसिष्ठ: Vasishta, इक्ष्वाकुकुलदैवतम् spiritual protector of Ikshvaku race, सर्वेषु in all, कृत्येषु ceremonies, वक्ता spokesman, ते to you, विदितम् is known.

text: विश्वामित्राभ्यनुज्ञातस्सह सर्वैर्महर्षिभि: एष वक्ष्यति धर्मात्मा वसिष्ठो मे यथाक्रमम् ॥१-७०-१७॥
translation: "Having been permitted by Viswamitra, along with all maharshis virtuous Vasishta will tell you in detail about my race".
word_meanings: सर्वै: by all, महर्षिभि: सह along with maharshis, विश्वामित्राभ्यनुज्ञात: having been permitted by Visvamitra, धर्मात्मा virtuous, एष: वसिष्ठ: this Vasishta, यथाक्रमम् in detailed order, मे my (race), वक्ष्यति will tell you.

text: एवमुक्त्वा नरश्रेष्ठे राज्ञां मध्ये महात्मनाम् तूष्णींभूते दशरथे वसिष्ठो भगवानृषि: । उवाच वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञो वैदेहं सपुरोधसम् ॥१-७०-१८॥
translation: Having said this amidst the best of men and the most distinguished among kings, Dasaratha remained silent. Then Vasishta, the venerable sage, wellversed in speech spoke to the Lord of Videhas (Janaka) in the midst of priests.
word_meanings: नरश्रेष्ठे when the best among men, दशरथे Dasaratha, महात्मनाम् of the distinguished, राज्ञाम् kings, मध्ये amidst, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा having spoken, तूष्णींभूते remained silent, वाक्यज्ञ: wellversed in speech, भगवान् adorable, वसिष्ठ: ऋषिः Vasishta, सपुरोधसम् in the company of priests, वैदेहम् Janaka, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke.

text: एवमुक्त्वा नरश्रेष्ठे राज्ञां मध्ये महात्मनाम् तूष्णींभूते दशरथे वसिष्ठो भगवानृषि: । उवाच वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञो वैदेहं सपुरोधसम् ॥१-७०-१९॥
translation: Having said this amidst the best of men and the most distinguished among kings, Dasaratha remained silent. Then Vasishta, the venerable sage, wellversed in speech spoke to the Lord of Videhas (Janaka) in the midst of priests.
word_meanings: नरश्रेष्ठे when the best among men, दशरथे Dasaratha, महात्मनाम् of the distinguished, राज्ञाम् kings, मध्ये amidst, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा having spoken, तूष्णींभूते remained silent, वाक्यज्ञ: wellversed in speech, भगवान् adorable, वसिष्ठ: ऋषिः Vasishta, सपुरोधसम् in the company of priests, वैदेहम् Janaka, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke.

text: अव्यक्तप्रभवो ब्रह्मा शाश्वतो नित्य अव्यय: । तस्मान्मरीचि स्संजज्ञे मरीचे: काश्यप: सुत: ॥१-७०-२०॥
translation: "From the unmanifest was born the eternal, the constant, the imperishable Brahma. To him was born Marichi and to Marichi, Kasyapa.
word_meanings: अव्यक्तप्रभव: the unmanifest, शाश्वत: eternal, नित्य: constant, अव्यय: Imperishable, ब्रह्मा Brahma, तस्मात् from him, मरीचि: Marichi, संजज्ञे was born, मरीचे: from Marichi, काश्यप: Kasyapa, सुत: son (sprang).

text: विवस्वान् काश्यपाज्जज्ञे मनुर्वैवस्वत स्स्मृत: । मनु: प्रजापति: पूर्वमिक्ष्वाकुस्तु मनोस्सुत: ॥१-७०-२१॥
translation: Kasyapa begot Vivasvan and Vivasvan, Manu. Ikshavaku was the son of Manu otherwise called Prajapati or Vaivasvata.
word_meanings: काश्यपात् from Kasyapa, विवस्वान् Vivasvan, जज्ञे was begotten, वैवस्वत: as Vivasvata, मनु: Manu, स्मृत: said, मनु: Manu, पूर्वम् formerly, प्रजापति: prajapati, इक्ष्वाकु: Ikshavaku, मनो: Manu's, सुत: son.

text: तमिक्ष्वाकुमयोध्यायां राजानं विद्धि पूर्वकम् । इक्ष्वाकोस्तु सुतश्श्रीमान् कुक्षिरित्येव विश्रुत: ॥१-७०-२२॥
translation: It may be noted that Ikshvaku was the first ancestral king of Ayodhya whose son was the wellknown, glorious Kukshi.
word_meanings: तम् इक्ष्वाकुम् him as Ikshvaku, अयोध्यायाम् in the city of Ayodhya, पूर्वकम् राजानम् ancestral king, विद्धि be informed, श्रीमान् the glorious, कुक्षिरित्येव known as Kukshi, विश्रुत: wellknown, इक्ष्वाको: Ikshvaku's, सुत: son(was born).

text: कुक्षेरथात्मज: श्रीमान् विकुक्षिरुदपद्यत । विकुक्षेस्तु महातेजा बाण: पुत्र: प्रतापवान् ॥१-७०-२३॥
translation: Prosperous Vikukshi was Kukshi's son, who brought forth brilliant and powerful Bana.
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, कुक्षे: Kushi's, श्रीमान् prosperous, विकुक्षि: Vikushi, आत्मज: as son, उदपद्यत was born, महातेजा: highly lustrous, प्रतापवान् valourous, बाण: Bana, विकुक्षे: Vikushi's, पुत्र: son.

text: बाणस्य तु महातेजा अनरण्य: प्रतापवान् । अनरण्यात्पृथुर्जज्ञे त्रिशङ्कुस्तु पृथोस्सुत: ॥१-७०-२४॥
translation: Bana's son was the most brilliant and valiant Anaranya whose son Pruthu was succeeded by Trisanku.
word_meanings: महातेजा: highly splendrous, प्रतापवान् valourous, अनरण्य: Anaranya, बाणस्य Bana's, अनरण्यात् from Anaranya, पृथु: Pruthu, जज्ञे born, त्रिशङ्कु: तु Trishanku, पृथो Pruthu's, सुत: son.

text: त्रिशङ्कोरभवत्पुत्रो दुन्दुमारो महायशा: । युवनाश्वसुतस्त्वासीन्मान्धाता पृथिवीपति: ॥१-७०-२५॥
translation: Trisanku's famous son was Dundumara also known as Yuvanashva whose son was king Mandhata.
word_meanings: त्रिशङ्को: of Trishanku, महायशा: highly famous, दुन्दुमार: Dundumara, पुत्र: अभवत् born as a son, मान्धाता known as Mandhata, पृथिवीपति: king, युवनाश्वसुत: son of Yuvanashva, आसीत् was born.

text: मान्धातुस्तु सुत श्श्रीमान् सुसन्धिरुदपद्यत । सुसन्धेरपि पुत्रौ द्वौ ध्रुवसन्धि: प्रसेनजित् ॥१-७०-२६॥
translation: Mandhata's son was prosperous Susandhi who brought forth two sons Dhruvasandhi and Prasenajit.
word_meanings: मान्धातु: for Mandhata, सुसन्धि: Susandhi, श्रीमान् venerable, उदपद्यत was born, सुसन्धेरपि for Susandhi, ध्रुवसन्धि: Dhruvasandhi, प्रसेनजित् Prasenajit, द्वौ two, पुत्रौ sons.

text: यशस्वी ध्रुवसन्धेस्तु भरतो नाम नामत: । भरतात्तु महातेजा असितो नाम जातवान् ॥१-७०-२७॥
translation: To Dhruvasandhi was born the wellknown Bharata who begot the vigorous Asita.
word_meanings: ध्रुवसन्धे: तु for Dhruvasandhi, नामत: by name, भरत: नाम known Bharata, यशस्वी illustrious, भरतात् from Bharata, महातेजा: highly vigoruos, असितो नाम named Asita, जातवान् begot.

text: यस्यैते प्रतिराजान उदपद्यन्त शत्रव: । हैहयास्तालजंघाश्च शूराश्च शशिबिन्दव: ॥१-७०-२८॥
translation: Valiant kings belonging to the races of the Haihayas, Talaiangha, and Sasibindus became the enemies to Asita.
word_meanings: यस्य for Asita, हैहया: Haihayas, तालजंघाश्च Talajanghas, शूरा: valiant men, शशिबिन्दवश्च Sasibindus, एते प्रतिराजान: kings fighting against him, शत्रव: enemies, उदपद्यन्त arose.

text: तांस्तु स प्रतियुध्यन् वै युद्धे राजा प्रवासित: । हिमवन्तमुपागम्य भृगुप्रस्रवणेऽवसत् असितोऽल्पबलो राजा मन्त्रिभिस्सहितस्तदा ॥१-७०-२९॥
translation: The king Asita who was a weakling was defeated in the conflict against the kings and was exiled. Along with his counsellors he lived at on the Bhriguprasravana Himavat mountain.
word_meanings: स: राजा that king, तान् them, युद्धे in the conflict, प्रतियुध्यन् fighting against them, प्रवासित: was exiled from his kingdom, राजा असित: king Asita, अल्पबल: with relatively lesser strength, मन्त्रिभि: with counsellors, सहित: accompanied, तदा then, हिमवन्तम् towards Himavat mountain, उपागम्य having reached, भृगुप्रस्रवणे in a place known as Bhriguprasravana, अवसत् lived.

text: द्वे चास्य भार्ये गर्भिण्यौ बभूवतुरिति श्रुतम् एका गर्भविनाशाय सपत्न्यै सगरं ददौ ॥१-७०-३०॥
translation: It is said that his (Asita's) two wives were pregnant. One gave food mixed with poison to the other with the intention of destroying her embryo.
word_meanings: अस्य his, द्वे two, भार्ये wives, गर्भिण्यौ pregnant, बभूवतु: became, इति thus, श्रुतम् is known, एका one, गर्भविनाशाय to destroy the embryo, सपत्नयै the other wife, सगरम् poison mixed in food, ददौ gave.

text: तत श्शैलवरं रम्यं बभूवाभिरतो मुनि: भार्गवश्च्यवनो नाम हिमवन्तमुपाश्रित: ॥१-७०-३१॥
translation: At that time Chyavana of the family of Bhrigu liked to stay at Himavat, the great, pleasant mountain.
word_meanings: तत: afterwards, रम्यम् delightful, शैलवरम् best of mountains, अभिरत: relished, भार्गव: of the family of Bhrigu, च्यवनो नाम named Chyavana, हिमवन्तम् Himavt, उपाश्रित: has taken refuge.

text: तत्रैका तु महाभागा भार्गवं देववर्चसम् ववन्दे पद्मपत्राक्षी काङ्क्षन्ती सुतमात्मन: ॥१-७०-३२॥
translation: That the lotuseyed and highly accomplished Kalindi, offered herself for a son to Chyavana who was glowing like a god.
word_meanings: महाभागा highly accomplished, तत्र (तयो:) एका one of those two, पद्मपत्राक्षी lotuseyed, आत्मन: for her, सुतम् son, काङ्क्षन्ती desiring, देववर्चसम् resembling the lustre of devatas, भार्गवम् Chyavana, ववन्दे offered salutations.

text: तमृषिं साऽभ्युपागम्य कालिंदी चाभ्यवादयत् स तामभ्यवदद्विप्र: पुत्रेप्सुं पुत्रजन्मनि ॥१-७०-३३॥
translation: Having approached the ascetic. Kalindi paid obeisance to him who said:
word_meanings: सा that, कालिंदी च Kalindi also, तम् that, ऋषिम् ascetic, अभ्युपागम्य after approaching, अभ्यवादयत् paid obeisance, स: that, विप्र: brahmin, ताम् her, पुत्रेप्सुम् desiring son, पुत्रजन्मनि concerning the birth of a son to her, अभ्यवदत् spoke.

text: तव कुक्षौ महाभागे सुपुत्रस्सुमहाबल: महावीर्यो महातेजा अचिरात्सञ्जनिष्यति । गरेण सहित श्श्रीमान् मा शुच: कमलेक्षणे ॥१-७०-३४॥
translation: 'O Great lady a child of high prowess, lustre and virtues is growing in your womb. In a short time this glorious son carrying with him the poison (administered to you) will be born. O Lotuseyed lady, do not grieve'.
word_meanings: महाभागे O Prosperous one, तव your, कुक्षौ in womb, सुमहाबल: having great prowess, महातेजा: highly lustrous, सुपुत्र: virtuous child, श्रीमान् glorious, गरेण with poison, सहित: furnished, अचिरात् in a short time, सञ्जनिष्यति will be born, कमलेक्षणे O Lotus eyedone, मा शुच: do not grieve.

text: तव कुक्षौ महाभागे सुपुत्रस्सुमहाबल: महावीर्यो महातेजा अचिरात्सञ्जनिष्यति । गरेण सहित श्श्रीमान् मा शुच: कमलेक्षणे ॥१-७०-३५॥
translation: 'O Great lady a child of high prowess, lustre and virtues is growing in your womb. In a short time this glorious son carrying with him the poison (administered to you) will be born. O Lotuseyed lady, do not grieve'.
word_meanings: महाभागे O Prosperous one, तव your, कुक्षौ in womb, सुमहाबल: having great prowess, महातेजा: highly lustrous, सुपुत्र: virtuous child, श्रीमान् glorious, गरेण with poison, सहित: furnished, अचिरात् in a short time, सञ्जनिष्यति will be born, कमलेक्षणे O Lotus eyedone, मा शुच: do not grieve.

text: च्यवनं तु नमस्कृत्य राजपुत्री पतिव्रता । पतिशोकातुरा तस्मात्पुत्रं देवी व्यजायत ॥१-७०-३६॥
translation: This eldest queen who was a devoted wife, afflicted with sorrow due to loss of her husband gave birth to a son by the grace of Chyavana.
word_meanings: राजपुत्री princess, पतिव्रता chaste and virtuous one, पतिशोकातुरा afflicted with the sorrow due to loss of her husband, देवी that eldest queen, च्यवनम् Chyavana, नमस्कृत्य having saluted him, तस्मात् for that husband, पुत्रम् son, व्यजायत gave birth.

text: सपत्न्या तु गरस्तस्यै दत्तो गर्भजिघांसया । सह तेन गरेणैव जात: स सगरोऽभवत् ॥१-७०-३७॥
translation: Since poison was given to her by her rival queen with the intention of destroying the embryo, the son was born with poison and so came to be known as Sagara.
word_meanings: सपत्न्या by her rival queen, तस्यै for her, गर्भजिघांसया with the intention of destroying embryo, गर: poison, दत्त: was given, तेन by that, गरेण सह एव with poison itself, जात: was born, स: that, सगर: sagara, अभवत् became.

text: सगरस्यासमञ्जस्तु असमञ्जात्तथांऽशुमान् । दिलीपोंऽशुमत: पुत्रो दिलीपस्य भगीरथ: ॥१-७०-३८॥
translation: Asamanja was the son of Sagara and to him was born Anshuman. Dilipa was the son of Anshuman and father of Bhagiratha.
word_meanings: असमञ्ज: Asamanjasa, सगरस्य Sagara's, तथा also, असमञ्जात् from Asamanja, अंशुमान् Anshuman, दिलीप: Dilipa, अंशुमत: Anshuman's, पुत्र: son, भगीरथ: Bhagiratha, दिलीपस्य Dilipa's (son).

text: भगीरथात्ककुत्स्थश्च ककुत्स्थस्य रघुस्सुत: । रघोस्तु पुत्रस्तेजस्वी प्रवृद्ध: पुरुषादक: कल्माषपादो ह्यभवत्तस्माज्जातस्तु शंखण: ॥१-७०-३९॥
translation: Bhagiratha begot Kakustha whose son was Raghu. Powerful Pravriddha was Raghu's son. He became Purushadaka (cannibal), on the curse of Vasistha. He grasped water in order to retaliate Vasishta but was prevented by his wife. The water fell on his feet and he came to be known as Kalmashapada (feet polluted with water). Samkhana was born to him.
word_meanings: भगीरथात् from Bhagiratha, ककुत्स्थ: Kakutsthsa, रघु: Raghu, ककुत्स्थस्य Kakutsthsa's, सुत: son, तेजस्वी powerful, प्रवृद्ध: Pravriddha, रघो: Raghu's, पुत्र: son, पुरुषादक: Purushadaka, कल्माषपाद: Kalmashapada, अभवत् became, तस्मात् for him, शंखण: Samkhana, जात: was born.

text: सुदर्शन: शङ्घणस्य अग्निवर्ण स्सुदर्शनात् शीघ्रगस्त्वग्निवर्णस्य शीघ्रगस्य मरु स्सुत: । मरो: प्रशुश्रुकस्त्वासीदम्बरीष: प्रशुश्रृकात् ॥१-७०-४०॥
translation: Sudarsana was the son of Samkhana. His son was Agnivarna. To Agnivarna was born Sighraga and to Sighraga, Maru. To Maru, was born Prasusruka and to Prasrusuka, Ambarisha.
word_meanings: शङ्घणस्य for Samkhana, सुदर्शन: Sudarsana, सुदर्शनात् from Sudarsana, अग्निवर्ण: Agnivarna, अग्निवर्णस्य for AgniVarna, शीघ्रग: Sighraga, शीघ्रगस्य for sighraga, मरु: Maru, सुत: son, मरो: for Maru, प्रशुश्रुक: Prasusruka, प्रशुश्रुकात् from Prasusukra, अम्बरीष: Ambarisha, आसीत् were born.

text: सुदर्शन: शङ्घणस्य अग्निवर्ण स्सुदर्शनात् शीघ्रगस्त्वग्निवर्णस्य शीघ्रगस्य मरु स्सुत: । मरो: प्रशुश्रुकस्त्वासीदम्बरीष: प्रशुश्रृकात् ॥१-७०-४१॥
translation: Sudarsana was the son of Samkhana. His son was Agnivarna. To Agnivarna was born Sighraga and to Sighraga, Maru. To Maru, was born Prasusruka and to Prasrusuka, Ambarisha.
word_meanings: शङ्घणस्य for Samkhana, सुदर्शन: Sudarsana, सुदर्शनात् from Sudarsana, अग्निवर्ण: Agnivarna, अग्निवर्णस्य for AgniVarna, शीघ्रग: Sighraga, शीघ्रगस्य for sighraga, मरु: Maru, सुत: son, मरो: for Maru, प्रशुश्रुक: Prasusruka, प्रशुश्रुकात् from Prasusukra, अम्बरीष: Ambarisha, आसीत् were born.

text: अम्बरीषस्य पुत्रोऽभून्नहुष: पृथिवीपति: । नहुषस्य ययातिस्तु नाभागस्तु ययातिज: ॥१-७०-४२॥
translation: King Nahusha was the son of Ambarisha. To Nahusha was born Yayati whose son was Nabhaga.
word_meanings: पृथिवीपति: king, नहुष: Nahusha, अम्बरीषस्य Ambarisha's, पुत्र: son, अभूत् became, नहुषस्य Nahusha's, ययाति: Yayati was born, नाभाग: Nabhaga , ययातिज: was born to Yayati.

text: नाभागस्य बभूवाज: अजाद्दशरथोऽभवत् । अस्माद्दशरथाज्जातौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥१-७०-४३॥
translation: Nabhaga's son was Aja. Aja was the father of Dasaratha and Dasaratha, the father of Rama and Lakshmana.
word_meanings: नाभागस्य Nabhaga's, अज: Aja, बभूव was born, अजात् from Aja, दशरथ: Dasaratha, अभवत् was born, अस्मात् from this, दशरथात् from Dasaratha, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, जातौ were born.

text: एवं ब्रुवाणं जनक: प्रत्युवाच कृताञ्जलि: । श्रोतुमर्हसि भद्रं ते कुलं न: परिकीर्तितम् ॥१-७१-१॥
translation: Vasishta having thus described (the genealogy of Dasaratha) Janaka with folded hands rejoined, "Be blessed. Let me relate the genealogy of my race. Listen".
word_meanings: एवम् in this manner, ब्रुवाणम् speaking (Vasishta), जनक: Janaka, कृताञ्जलि: with folded palms, प्रत्युवाच replied, ते भद्रं safety to you, परिकीर्तितम् related, न: our, कुलम् genealogy, श्रोतुम् to listen, अर्हसि behoves of you.

text: प्रदाने हि मुनिश्रेष्ठ कुलं निरवशेषत: । वक्तव्यं कुलजातेन तन्निबोध महामुने ॥१-७१-२॥
translation: "O Great sage O Best of ascetics while one offers his daughter (in marriage), one born in a noble family should describe his genealogy in full. Listen.
word_meanings: मुनिश्रेष्ठ O Best of ascetics, महामुने O Great sage, कुलजातेन by one born in a noble family, प्रदाने at the time of bestowing their daughter in marriage, निरवशेषत: completely, कुलम् geneology of dynasty, वक्तव्यं हि indeed to be told, तत् that, निबोध listen to the same.

text: राजाऽभूत् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुत स्स्वेन कर्मणा । निमि: परमधर्मात्मा सर्वसत्त्ववतां वर: ॥१-७१-३॥
translation: There was a great man of religion king Nimi, strongest of men and wellknown in the three worlds by his own acts.
word_meanings: स्वेन by his own, कर्मणा acts, त्रिषु three, लोकेषु worlds, विश्रुत: known, परमधर्मात्मा supremely virtuous, सर्वसत्त्ववताम् those endowed with strength, वर: best, राजा निमि: अभूत् was king named Nimi.

text: तस्य पुत्रोमिथिर्नाम मिथिला येन निर्मिता । प्रथमो जनको नाम जनकादप्युदावसु: ॥१-७१-४॥
translation: Nimi begot a son named Mithi who constructed Mithila. He was the first Janaka whose son was Udavasu.
word_meanings: मिथिर्नाम named Mithi, तस्य his, पुत्र: son, येन निर्मिता by whom constructed, मिथिला Mithila प्रथम: first, जनक: Janaka, नाम named, जनकाद् from Janaka, उदावसु: Udavasu was born.

text: उदावसोस्तु धर्मात्मा जातो वै नन्दिवर्धन: । नन्दिवर्धनपुत्रस्तु सुकेतुर्नाम नामत: ॥१-७१-५॥
translation: Virtuous Nandivardhana was the son of Udavasu whose son was Suketu.
word_meanings: उदावसो: तु for that Udavasu, धर्मात्मा righteous, नन्दिवर्धन: Nandivardha, जात: was born, नन्दिवर्धनपुत्र: तु the son of Nandivardhana, नामत: by name, सुकेतुर्नाम named Suketu.

text: सुकेतोरपि धर्मात्मा देवरातो महाबल: । देवरातस्य राजर्षेर्बृहद्रथ इति स्मृत: ॥१-७१-६॥
translation: Suketu's son was the righteous and powerful Devarata, father of Brihadradha.
word_meanings: सुकेतो: अपि for that Suketu, धर्मात्मा righteous, महाबल: highly powerful, देवरात: Devarata, राजर्षे: rishi among kings, देवरातस्य for that Devarata, बृहद्रथ Brihadradha, इति स्मृत: known as.

text: बृहद्रथस्य शूरोऽभून्महावीर: प्रतापवान् । महावीरस्य धृतिमान् सुधृतिस्सत्यविक्रम: ॥१-७१-७॥
translation: Brihadradha's son was the heroic and powerful Mahavira, father of Sudhruti, who was armed with courage and the power of truth.
word_meanings: बृहद्रथस्य for Brihadradha, शूर: heroic, प्रतापवान् valourous, महावीर: Mahavera, महावीरस्य Mahaveera's, धृतिमान् courageous, सत्यविक्रम: having truthful prowess, सुधृति: Sudhruti was born.

text: सुधृतेरपि धर्मात्मा दृष्टकेतुस्सुधार्मिक: । दृष्टकेतोस्तु राजर्षेर्हर्यश्व इति विश्रुत: ॥१-७१-८॥
translation: To Sudhruti was born the righteous Drishtaketu, committed to dharma. Rajarshi Drishtaketu was father to the wellknown Haryasva.
word_meanings: सुधृते: for Sudhruti, धर्मात्मा righteous, सुधार्मिक: committed to dharma, दृष्टकेतु: Drishtaketu, राजर्षे: of that royal rishi, दृष्टकेतो: for Drishtaketu, हर्यश्व: Haryasva, इति विश्रुत: thus well known (son was born.)

text: हर्यश्वस्य मरु: पुत्रो मरो: पुत्र: प्रतिन्धक: । प्रतिंधकस्य धर्मात्मा राजा कीर्तिरथस्सुत: ॥१-७१-९॥
translation: Haryasva's son was Maru, father of Pratindhaka. Pratindhaka's son was the righteous king Kirtiratha.
word_meanings: हर्यश्वस्य Haryasva's, मरु: Maru, पुत्र: son, मरो: for Meru, प्रतिन्धक: Pratindhaka, पुत्र: son, धर्मात्मा righteous, राजा king, कीर्तिरथ: Kirtiratha, प्रतिन्धकस्य Pratindhaka's, सुत: son.

text: पुत्र: कीर्तिरथस्यापि देवमीढ इति स्मृत: । देवमीढस्य विबुधो विबुधस्य महीध्रक: ॥१-७१-१०॥
translation: The son of Kirtiratha was known as Devamidha. His son was Vibudha, father of Mahidhraka.
word_meanings: कीर्तिरथस्यापि Kirtiratha's, पुत्र: son, देवमीढ इति as Devamidha, स्मृत: has been known, देवमीढस्य Devamidha's son, विबुध: was Vibudha, विबुधस्य Vibhuda's son, महीध्रक: was Mahidhraka.

text: महीध्रकसुतो राजा कीर्तिरातो महाबल: । कीर्तिरातस्य राजर्षेर्महारोमा व्यजायत ॥१-७१-११॥
translation: Mighty king Kirtirata was the son of Mahidhraka. He was a Rajarshi, father of Maharoma.
word_meanings: महाबल: mighty, राजा कीर्तिरात: king Kirtirata, महीध्रकसुत: son of Mahidhraka, राजर्षेः of that royal rishi, कीर्तिरातस्य Kirtirata's, महारोमा Maharoma, व्यजायत born.

text: महारोम्णस्तु धर्मात्मा स्वर्णरोमा व्यजायत । स्वर्णरोम्णस्तु राजर्षेर्ह्रस्वरोमा व्यजायत ॥१-७१-१२॥
translation: To Maharoma's was born the virtuous Swarnaroma. Swarnaroma's son was Hrasvaroma.
word_meanings: महारोम्ण: तु for Maharoma, स्वर्णरोमा Swarnaroma, व्यजायत was born, राजर्षेः of the royal rishi, स्वर्णरोम्ण: तु for Swarnaroma, ह्रस्वरोमा Hrasvaroma, व्यजायत was born.

text: तस्य पुत्रद्वयं जज्ञे धर्मज्ञस्य महात्मन: । ज्येष्ठोऽहमनुजो भ्राता मम वीर: कुशध्वज: ॥१-७१-१३॥
translation: Hrasvaroma, was a religious king. He was a great soul. Of his two sons. I am the eldest and valiant Kusadhwaja is my younger brother.
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञस्य knower of morality and ethics, तस्य of that, महात्मन: magnanimous, पुत्रद्वयम् two sons, जज्ञे were born, अहम् I am, ज्येष्ट: eldest, वीर: valiant, कुशध्वज: Kusadhwaja, मम my, अनुज: younger, भ्राता brother.

text: मां तु ज्येष्ठं पिता राज्ये सोऽभिषिच्य नराधिप: । कुशध्वजं समावेश्य भारं मयि वनं गत: ॥१-७१-१४॥
translation: My father king Hrasvaroma crowned me king, entrusted Kusadhwaja to my care and retired to the forest.
word_meanings: पिता father, स: नराधिप: king Hrasvaroma, ज्येष्ठं eldest, माम् me, राज्ये in the kingdom, अभिषिच्य having crowned me, कुशध्वजं Kusadhwaja, भारम् responsibility of supporting, मयि in me, समावेश्य placeing, वनम् forest, गत: went.

text: वृद्धे पितरि स्वर्याते धर्मेण धुरमावहम् । भ्रातरं देवसङ्काशं स्नेहात्पश्यन् कुशध्वजम् ॥१-७१-१५॥
translation: After my aged father attained heaven, I looked after my brother Kusadhwaja, who resembles the celestials, affectionately and ruled the kingdom with righteousness.
word_meanings: वृद्धे when the aged, पितरि father, स्वर्याते सति had attained heaven, भ्रातरम् brother, देवसङ्काशम् resembling devatas, कुशध्वजम् Kusadhwaja, स्नेहात् affectionately, पश्यन् looking after, धर्मेण with righteousness, धुरम weight of ruling the kingdom, आवहम् bore.

text: कस्य चित्त्वथकालस्य साङ्काश्यादगमत्पुरात् । सुधन्वा वीर्यवान्राजा मिथिलामवरोधक: ॥१-७१-१६॥
translation: A little later a powerful king named Sudhanva from the city of Sankasya beseiged Mithila.
word_meanings: अथ thereafter, कस्यचित् कालस्य after sometime, वीर्यवान् powerful, सुधन्वा राजा king Sundhava, मिथिलाम् Mithila, अवरोधक: with a view to beseige, साङ्काश्यात् from Sankasya, पुरात् city, अगमत् set out.

text: स च मे प्रेषयामास शैवं धनुरनुत्तमम् । सीता कन्या च पद्माक्षी मह्यं वै दीयतामिति ॥१-७१-१७॥
translation: He (Sudhanva) sent me a message: 'give me the great bow of Siva and the lotuseyed maiden Sita'.
word_meanings: अनुत्तमम् excellent, शैवं धनु: bow of Siva, पद्माक्षी lotuseyed, कन्या maiden, सीता च Sita also, मह्यम् to me, दीयताम् be given, इति thus, प्रेषयामास sent a message.

text: तस्याप्रदानाद्ब्रह्मर्षे युद्धमासीन्मया सह । स हतोऽभिमुखो राजा सुधन्वा तु मया रणे ॥१-७१-१८॥
translation: O Brahmarshi when I refused, a great conflict broke out between him and me. In the encounter king Sudhanva was killed by me.
word_meanings: ब्रह्मर्षे O Brahmarshi, अप्रदानात् by not offering, तस्य for him, मया सह with me, युद्धम् असीत् great conflict broke, रणे in the battle, अभिमुख: he in an encounter, स: that, सुधन्वा राजा king Sudhanva, मया by me, हत: killed.

text: निहत्य तं मुनिश्रेष्ठ सुधन्वानं नराधिपम् । साङ्काश्ये भ्रातरं वीरमभ्यषिञ्चं कुशध्वजम् ॥१-७१-१९॥
translation: O Best of ascetics having killed king Sudhanva, I have crowned my heroic brother Kusadhwaja in Sankasya.
word_meanings: मुनिश्रेष्ठ O Best of ascetics, नराधिपम् king, तम् that, सुधन्वानम् Sudhanva, निहत्य having killed, भ्रातरम् brother, वीरम् heroic one, कुशध्वजम् Kusadhwaja, साङ्काश्ये in Sankasya, अभ्यषिञ्चम् I have crowned.

text: कनीयानेष मे भ्राता अहं ज्येष्ठो महामुने । ददामि परमप्रीतो वध्वौ ते मुनिपुङ्गव सीतां रामाय भद्रं ते ऊर्मिला लक्ष्मणाय च ॥१-७१-२०॥
translation: O Great ascetic (Vasishta), this one is my youger brother and I am the elder one. O preeminent among ascetics with immense pleasure I am giving these maidens, Sita to Rama and Urmila to Lakshmana. Be blessed
word_meanings: महामुने O Great ascetic, एष: this one, मे my, कनीयान् youger, भ्राता brother, अहम् I, ज्येष्ठ: elder, मुनिपुङ्गव preeminent among ascetics, परमप्रीत: immensely pleased, ते those, वध्वौ two maidens, ददामि I am giving, सीतां रामाय Sita to Rama, ऊर्मिला लक्ष्मणाय Urmila to Lakshmana, ते भद्रम् prosperity to you.

text: वीर्यशुल्कां मम सुतां सीतां सुरसुतोपमाम् द्वितीयामूर्मिलां चैव त्रिर्ददामि न संशय: ॥१-७१-२१॥
translation: I offer my daughter Sita, who looks like a celestial maiden as reward for (Rama's) prowess and my second daughter Urmila (to Lakshmana). I proclaim it three times so that there is no doubt about it.
word_meanings: वीर्यशुल्काम् as reward for prowess, सुरसुतोपमाम् equal to the daughter of devatas, मम सुताम् my daughter, सीताम् Sita, द्वितीयाम् second daughter, ऊर्मिलां चैव Urmila also, त्रि: three times, ददामि bestowing, संशय: न no doubt.

text: ददामि परमप्रीतो वध्वौ ते रघुनन्दन रामलक्ष्मणयो राजन् गोदानं कारयस्व ह । पितृकार्यं च भद्रं ते ततो वैवाहिकं कुरु ॥१-७१-२२॥
translation: O Delight of the Raghus (King Dasaratha), I offer these brides with immense pleasure to Rama and Lakshmana. You may perform the rites for your forefathers by gift of cows. Prosperity to you. Thereafter you may perform the marriage.
word_meanings: रघुनन्दन O King Dasaratha, परमप्रीत: immensely pleased, ते to you, वध्वौ brides, ददामि I am giving, राजन् O King, रामलक्ष्मणयो: to Rama and Lakshmana, गोदानम् distribution of cows, कारयस्व ह let it be performed, पितृकार्यं च ritual duty towards pitris, भद्रं ते prosperity to you, तत: thereafter, वैवाहिकम् कुरु let the marriage be performed.

text: ददामि परमप्रीतो वध्वौ ते रघुनन्दन रामलक्ष्मणयो राजन् गोदानं कारयस्व ह । पितृकार्यं च भद्रं ते ततो वैवाहिकं कुरु ॥१-७१-२३॥
translation: O Delight of the Raghus (King Dasaratha), I offer these brides with immense pleasure to Rama and Lakshmana. You may perform the rites for your forefathers by gift of cows. Prosperity to you. Thereafter you may perform the marriage.
word_meanings: रघुनन्दन O King Dasaratha, परमप्रीत: immensely pleased, ते to you, वध्वौ brides, ददामि I am giving, राजन् O King, रामलक्ष्मणयो: to Rama and Lakshmana, गोदानम् distribution of cows, कारयस्व ह let it be performed, पितृकार्यं च ritual duty towards pitris, भद्रं ते prosperity to you, तत: thereafter, वैवाहिकम् कुरु let the marriage be performed.

text: मखा ह्यद्य महाबाहो तृतीये दिवसे प्रभो । फल्गुन्यामुत्तरे राजंस्तस्मिन्वैवाहिकं कुरु रामलक्ष्मणयो राजन् दानं कार्यं सुखोदयम् ॥१-७१-२४॥
translation: Today the star Makha is on the ascendant. O King perform the marriage on the, third day from today under UttaraPhalguni star. Gifts may be given for the happiness of Rama and Lakshmana". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे एकसप्ततितमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the seventyfirst sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: महाबाहो O Strong armed one, प्रभो (विभो) O Lord, अद्य today, मखा हि star Makha is on the ascendent, राजन् O King, तृतीये दिवसे third day from today, फल्गुन्याम् known as Phalguni, तस्मिन् in that, उत्तरे in the star Uttara, वैवाहिकम् marriage, कुरु perform, राजन् O King, रामलक्ष्मणयो: for Rama and Lakshmana, सुखोदयम् for enjoying felicity, दानम् distribution of kine, etc, कार्यम् fit to be done.

text: तमुक्तवन्तं वैदेहं विश्वामित्रो महामुनि: । उवाच वचनं वीरं वसिष्ठसहितो नृपम् ॥१-७२-१॥
translation: When Janaka the valiant king of Videha thus spoke (on the genealogy of his family) the mighty ascetic Viswamitra accompanied by Vasishta said to Janaka:
word_meanings: महामुनि: mighty ascetic, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, वसिष्ठसहित: accompanied by Vasista, उक्तवन्तम् thus spoken, वीरम् valiant, वैदेहम् king of Videha, नृपम् addressing king Janaka, वचनम् words, उवाच said.

text: अचिन्त्यान्यप्रमेयानि कुलानि नरपुङ्गव । इक्ष्वाकूणां विदेहानां नैषां तुल्योऽस्ति कश्चन ॥१-७२-२॥
translation: "O Preeminent among men the glory of the two races of Ikshvakus as also of Videhas is in comprehensible and immeasurable. There is none equal to these kings of the Ikshvakus and Videhas.
word_meanings: नरपुङ्गव O Preeminent among men, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of kings of Ikshvaku, विदेहानां च also of Videha, कुलानि races, अचिन्त्यानि beyond comprehension, अप्रमेयानि immeasurable, एषां for these kings of Ikshvaku and Videha, तुल्य: equal, कश्चन anyone, नास्ति is not there.

text: सदृशो धर्मसम्बन्ध: सदृशो रूपसम्पदा । रामलक्ष्मणयो राजन् सीता चोर्मिलया सह ॥१-७२-३॥
translation: O King it is a perfect match between Sita and Rama and Urmila and Lakshmana. In respect of piety and beauty the match is perfect.
word_meanings: राजन् O King, ऊर्मिलया सह along with Urmila, सीता Sita, रामलक्ष्मणयो: for Rama and Lakshmana (is being offered), सदृश: perfectly matched, धर्मसम्बन्ध: the marriage is in accordance with religious merit, रूपसम्पदाच in virtue and beauty, सदृश: is fit.

text: वक्तव्यं च नरश्रेष्ठ श्रूयतां वचनं मम । भ्राता यवीयान् धर्मज्ञ एष राजा कुशध्वज: ॥१-७२-४॥
translation: O Best of men my words deserve to be heard. This younger brother king Kusadhwaja is knower of righteousness.
word_meanings: नरश्रेष्ठ O Best of men, मम my, वक्तव्यं च is fit to be divulged, वचनम् words, श्रूयताम् may be heard, यवीयान् भ्राता this younger brother, एष: राजा this king, कुशध्वज: Kusadhwaja, धर्मज्ञ: knower of righteousness.

text: अस्य धर्मात्मनो राजन् रूपेणाप्रतिमं भुवि । सुताद्वयं नरश्रेष्ठ पत्न्यर्थं वरयामहे ॥१-७२-५॥
translation: O King, O Eminent among men we seek the hands of this virtuous king's two daughters, unrivalled in beauty, on earth, as consorts.
word_meanings: राजन् O King, नरश्रेष्ठ O Eminent among men, रूपेण in beauty, भुवि on this earth, अप्रतिमम् unrivalled, अस्य धर्मात्मन: this virtuous one's, सुताद्वयम् two daughters, पत्न्यर्थम् as consorts, वरयामहे we are seeking.

text: भरतस्य कुमारस्य शत्रुघ्नस्य च धीमत: । वरयामस्सुते राजन् तयोरर्थे महात्मनो: ॥१-७२-६॥
translation: O king we choose your brother's daughters for the great souls: the young Bharata and the sagacious Satrughna.
word_meanings: राजन् O King, कुमारस्य of the youthful, भरतस्य Bharata, धीमत: sagacious, शत्रुघ्नस्य च for Satrughna also, महात्मनो: for the magnanimous ones, तयोरर्थे in the interests of both of them, सुते two daughters, वरयाम: we choose.

text: पुत्रा दशरथस्येमे रूपयौवनशालिन: । लोकपालोपमास्सर्वे देवतुल्यपराक्रमा: ॥१-७२-७॥
translation: Bestowed with youth and beauty, these sons of Dasaratha resemble kings in defending the worlds and gods in valour.
word_meanings: इमे these, दशरथस्य पुत्रा: sons of Dasaratha, सर्वे all, रूपयौवनशालिन: shining with youth and beauty, लोकपालोपमा: resembling the kings who are the protectors of the worlds, देवतुल्यपराक्रमा: equal to devatas in valour.

text: उभयोरपि राजेन्द्र सम्बन्धेनानुबध्यताम् । इक्ष्वाको: कुलमव्यग्रं भवत:पुण्यकर्मण: ॥१-७२-८॥
translation: O King of kings (Janaka) the bond between your race with its pious deeds and the Ikshvakus may be strenghthened by this alliance".
word_meanings: राजेन्द्र O King, इक्ष्वाको: Ikshvaku's, पुण्यकर्मणः of pious deeds, भवत: your, उभयोरपि both of you, कुलम् races, सम्बन्धेन by this alliance, अन्यग्रम् with clear vision, अनुबध्यताम् let it be tied.

text: विश्वामित्रवच श्शृत्वा वसिष्ठस्य मते तदा । जनक: प्रांजलिर्वाक्यमुवाच मुनिपुङ्गवौ ॥१-७२-९॥
translation: Having heard the words of Viswamitra which echoed the wish of Vasishta, Janaka replied to the eminent ascetics with folded palms.
word_meanings: तदा then, वसिष्ठस्य Vasistha's, मते by wish, विश्वामित्रवच: Viswamitra's words, शृत्वा having listened, जनक: Janaka, प्रांजलि: with folded palms, मुनिपुङ्गवौ addressing eminent asetics, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke.

text: कुलं धन्यमिदं मन्ये येषां नो मुनिपुङ्गवौ । सदृशं कुलसम्बन्धं यदाज्ञापयथ: स्वयम् ॥१-७२-१०॥
translation: "Since both of you, eminent ascetics, recomended this befitting alliance of the two races on your own, I regard my race as blessed.
word_meanings: येषाम् न: for those of us, सदृशं befitting, कुलसम्बन्धम् alliance of the two races, मुनिपुङ्गवौ two eminent ascetics, स्वयम् on your own, यत् for which reason, आज्ञापयथ: are commanding, इदम् this, कुलम् race, धन्यम् blessed, मन्ये I consider.

text: एवं भवतु भद्रं व: कुशध्वजसुते इमे । पत्न्यौ भजेतां सहितौ शत्रुघ्नभरतावुभौ ॥१-७२-११॥
translation: "Let it be so, Be blessed Let these two daughters of Kusadhwaja (Srutakirti and Mandavi) be the wives of Satrughna and Bharata respectively and serve them.
word_meanings: एवं भवतु let it be so, व: भद्रं: prosperity to you, इमे these, कुशध्वजसुते daughters of Kusadhwaja, सहितौ together moving, शत्रुघ्नभरतौ for Satrughna and Bharata, उभौ for both of them, पत्न्यौ as wives, भजेताम् let them serve.

text: एकाह्ना राजपुत्रीणां चतसृणां महामुने । पाणीन् गृह्णन्तु चत्वारो राजपुत्रा महाबला: ॥१-७२-१२॥
translation: O Great ascetic let the valiant four princes take the hands of four princesses on the same day.
word_meanings: महामुने O Great ascetic, महाबला: valiant, चत्वार: four, राजपुत्रा: princes, एकाह्ना on the same day, चतसृ़णाम् of the four, राजपुत्रीणाम् princesses, पाणीन् hands, गृह्णन्तु let them take.

text: उत्तरे दिवसे ब्रह्मन् फल्गुनीभ्यां मनीषिण: । वैवाहिकं प्रशंसन्ति भगो यत्र प्रजापति: ॥१-७२-१३॥
translation: "The wise, O Brahmin think the marriage is favourable when Bhaga is Prajapati on the succeeding day of the ascent of the two stars. (that is, when poorva is followed by uttara phalguni).
word_meanings: ब्रह्मन् O Foremost among brahmins, फल्गुनीभ्याम् उत्तरे दिवसे on the later day of the ascent of the two Phalgunis (Phalgunis are two sisters. The previous day of the ascent of Phalguni stars, Poorva Phalguni wil be ascendent and the folowing day Uttara Phalguni wil be ascendant ), यत्र in which day, प्रजापति: bestower of children, भग: Bhaga, वैवाहिकम् to perform marriage, मनीषिण: wise people, प्रशंसन्ति are praising.

text: एवमुक्त्वा वचस्सौम्यं प्रत्युत्थाय कृताञ्जलि: । उभौ मुनिवरौ राजा जनको वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥१-७२-१४॥
translation: King Janaka, having spoken these pleasing words, stood up and with folded hands addressing both the great ascetics:
word_meanings: जनक: राजा king Janaka, एवम् thus, सौम्यम् pleasing, वच: words, उक्त्वा having spoken, प्रत्युत्थाय having stood up, कृताञ्जलि: with folded hands, उभौ both, मुनिवरौ great ascetics, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: परो धर्म: कृतो मह्यं शिष्योऽस्मिभवतो सदा । इमान्यासनमुख्यानि आसातां मुनिपुङ्गवौ ॥१-७२-१५॥
translation: "You have earned me a great religious merit. I shall be always your disciple O Eminent ascestics, occupy these important seats".
word_meanings: मह्यम् for me, पर: supreme, धर्म: religious merit, कृत: has been done, सदा always, भवतो: for both of you, शिष्य: अस्मि I am a desciple, मुनिपुङ्गवौ eninent ascestics, इमानि these, आसनमुख्यानि best of thrones, आसाताम् occupy.

text: यथा दशरथस्येयं तथाऽयोध्या पुरी मम । प्रभुत्वे नास्ति सन्देहो यथार्हं कर्तुमर्हथ ॥१-७२-१६॥
translation: "Dasaratha has right on the city of Ayodhya as much as I have on this. This right is unquestionable. So do whatever you think right".
word_meanings: इयम् this Mithila, दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, यथा as, अयोध्या पुरी Ayodhya city, मम to me, तथा so it is, प्रभुत्वे in the matter of governance, सन्देह: doubt, नास्ति not there, यथार्हम् appropriately, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हथ behoves of you.

text: तथा ब्रुवति वैदेहे जनके रघुनन्दन: । राजा दशरथो हृष्ट: प्रत्युवाच महीपतिम् ॥१-७२-१७॥
translation: To the words of Janaka, king of Videha, king Dasaratha, the descendant of Raghu cheerfully replied:
word_meanings: वैदेहे when the king of Videha, जनके Janaka, तथा in that manner, ब्रुवति while speaking, रघुनन्दन: descendent of Raghu, राजा दशरथ: king Dasaratha, हृष्ट: pleased, महीपतिम् addressing king Janaka, प्रत्युवाच replied.

text: युवामसङ्ख्येयगुणौ भ्रातरौ मिथिलेश्वरौ । ऋषयो राजसङ्घाश्च भवद्भ्यामभिपूजिता: ॥१-७२-१८॥
translation: "You both brothers are lords of Mithila. You possess countless virtues. You pay regards to many rishis and hosts of kings".
word_meanings: मिथिलेश्वरौ lords of Mithila, भ्रातरौ brothers, युवाम् both of you, असङ्ख्येयगुणौ have countless virtues, भवद्भ्याम् by you, ऋषय: rishis, राजसङ्घाश्च hosts of kings, अभिपूजिता: have been worshipped.

text: स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि भद्रं ते गमिष्यामि स्वमालयम् । श्राद्धकर्माणि सर्वाणि विधास्यामीति चाब्रवीत् ॥१-७२-१९॥
translation: "Be safe. Be blessed. Let me retire to the camp. I have to perform the rites offerings to the forefathers".
word_meanings: स्वस्ति safety, प्राप्नुहि you may obtain, ते भद्रम् prosperity to you, स्वम् relating to mine, आलयम् residence, गमिष्यामि I shall go, सर्वाणि all, श्राद्धकर्माणि rites concerning the ceremony in accordance with the rituals, विधास्यामि च I shall perform, इति thus, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: तमापृष्ट्वा नरपतिं राजा दशरथस्तदा । मुनीन्द्रौ तौ पुरस्कृत्य जगामाशु महायशा: ॥१-७२-२०॥
translation: Then renowned king Dasaratha, took leave of the two great ascetics. Then the rowned king Dasaratha took have of the king (Janaka) immediately following the two great ascetics.
word_meanings: तदा then, महायशा: renowned, राजा दशरथ: king Dasaratha, तम् that, नरपतिम् king men, आपृष्ट्वा having taken leave of, तौ those two, मुनीन्द्रौ ascetics, पुरस्कृत्य placing them in the forefront, आशु immediately, जगाम went away.

text: स गत्वा निलयं राजा श्राद्धं कृत्वा विधानत: । प्रभाते काल्यमुत्थाय चक्रे गोदानमुत्तमम् ॥१-७२-२१॥
translation: The king (Dasaratha) reached the abode, performed the sharaddha ceremony in accordance with the scriptures. Next day at dawn at appropriate time he gifted away cows (a ceremony performed by initiating the bridegrooms into the marriage.)
word_meanings: स: that, राजा king, निलयम् residence, गत्वा having gone, विधानत: according to scriptures, श्राद्धम् Shraddha ceremony, कृत्वा having performed, प्रभाते at dawn, उत्थाय having risen, काल्यम् appropriate to the time, उत्तमम् excellent, गोदानम् gifting of cows (a ceremony duly initiating the marriage, vow of Snathaka ), चक्रे made.

text: गवां शतसहस्राणि ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नराधिप: । एकैकशो ददौ राजा पुत्रानुद्दिश्य धर्मत: ॥१-७२-२२॥
translation: For the welfare of each of his sons the king (Dasaratha) religiously gave away a hundred thousand cows to brahmins.
word_meanings: नराधिप: lord of men, राजा king, पुत्रान् sons, एकैकश: for each one, उद्धिश्य referring to their names, ब्राह्मणेभ्य: for brahmins, गवाम् cows, शतसहस्राणि in hundred thousands, धर्मत: in accordance with law, ददौ bestowed.

text: सुवर्णश्रुङ्गा स्सम्पन्ना स्सवत्सा: कांस्यदोहना: । गवां शतसहस्राणि चत्वारि पुरुषर्षभ: वित्तमन्यच्च सुबहुद्विजेभ्यो रघुनन्दन: । ददौ गोदानमुद्दिश्य पुत्राणां पुत्रवत्सल: ॥१-७२-२३॥
translation: Great among men and affectionate towards his children, (king Dasaratha), the delight of the Raghus donated in the name of his sons' donates to the brahmins four hundred thousand cows. They were capable of abundance of milk. Their horns were plaited with gold. They were accompanied by calves. With them were given away bellmetal vessels for keeping milk and innumerable valuables.
word_meanings: पुरुषर्षभ: great among men, पुत्रवत्सल: affectionate towards his children, रघुनन्दन: Dasaratha, पुत्राणाम् sons', गोदानम् gifting away of cows, उद्धिश्य with reference to that, सुवर्णश्रुङ्गा: with their horns plaited with gold, सम्पन्ना: endowed with abundance(of milk), सवत्सा: accompanied by calves, कांस्यदोहना: bronze vessels for milking, गवाम् of cows, चत्वारि four, शतसहस्राणि a hundred thousand, अन्यत् other, सुबहु innumerable, वित्तम् च valuables, द्विजेभ्य: for brahmins, ददौ bestowed.

text: सुवर्णश्रुङ्गा स्सम्पन्ना स्सवत्सा: कांस्यदोहना: । गवां शतसहस्राणि चत्वारि पुरुषर्षभ: वित्तमन्यच्च सुबहुद्विजेभ्यो रघुनन्दन: । ददौ गोदानमुद्दिश्य पुत्राणां पुत्रवत्सल: ॥१-७२-२४॥
translation: Great among men and affectionate towards his children, (king Dasaratha), the delight of the Raghus donated in the name of his sons' donates to the brahmins four hundred thousand cows. They were capable of abundance of milk. Their horns were plaited with gold. They were accompanied by calves. With them were given away bellmetal vessels for keeping milk and innumerable valuables.
word_meanings: पुरुषर्षभ: great among men, पुत्रवत्सल: affectionate towards his children, रघुनन्दन: Dasaratha, पुत्राणाम् sons', गोदानम् gifting away of cows, उद्धिश्य with reference to that, सुवर्णश्रुङ्गा: with their horns plaited with gold, सम्पन्ना: endowed with abundance(of milk), सवत्सा: accompanied by calves, कांस्यदोहना: bronze vessels for milking, गवाम् of cows, चत्वारि four, शतसहस्राणि a hundred thousand, अन्यत् other, सुबहु innumerable, वित्तम् च valuables, द्विजेभ्य: for brahmins, ददौ bestowed.

text: स सुतै: कृतगोदानैर्वृतस्तु नृपतिस्तदा । लोकपालैरिवाभाति वृत: स्सौम्य: प्रजापति: ॥१-७२-२५॥
translation: With his sons for whose sake cows have been given away the cheerful king looked like shining Prajapati surrrounded by the guardians of the world. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे द्विसप्ततितमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the seventhsecond sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: कृतगोदानै: having distributed the cows, सुतै: with his sons, वृत: surrounded, स: that, नृपति: king, तदा then, लोकपालै: by guardians of worlds, वृत: surrounded, सौम्य: pleased, प्रजापतिरिव like brahma, आभाति shining.

text: यस्मिन् तु दिवसे राजा चक्रे गो दानम् उत्तमम् । तस्मिन् तु दिवसे शूरो युधाजित् समुपेयिवान् ॥१-७३-१॥
translation: The day the king (Dasaratha) made a gift of the best (available) cows the heroic Yudhajit arrived.
word_meanings: राजा king, यस्मिन् on which, दिवसे day, उत्तमम् best, गोदानम् gift of cows, चक्रे made, तस्मिन् तु on that दिवसे day, शूर: heroic, युथाजित् Yudhajit, समुपेयिवान् arrived.

text: पुत्रः केकय राजस्य साक्षात् भरत मातुलः । दृष्ट्वा पृष्ट्वा च कुशलम् राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-७३-२॥
translation: Yudhajit, son of king Kekaya, Bharata's own maternal uncle met the king (Dasaratha) and enquiring about his wellbeing said:
word_meanings: केकयराजस्य king Kekaya's, पुत्र: son, साक्षात् directly, भरतमातुल: maternal uncle of Bharata, राजानम् king Dasaratha, दृष्ट्वा having seen, कुशलम् welfare, पृष्ट्वा च having enquired, राजानम् addressing the king, इदं this word, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: केकय अधिपती राजा स्नेहात् कुशलम् अब्रवीत् । येषाम् कुशलकामो असि तेषाम् संप्रति अनामयम् ॥१-७३-३॥
translation: "My father, king of Kekaya affectionately enquires about your welfare. And they whose welfare you seek are hale and healthy.
word_meanings: केकयाधिपति: lord of Kekaya, राजा king, स्नेहात् out of affection, कुशलम् welfare, अब्रवीत् spoken, येषाम् whose, कुशलकाम: असि are desiring the welfare, तेषाम् their, सम्प्रति now, अनामयम् healthy.

text: स्वस्रीयम् मम राजेन्द्र द्रष्टु कामो महीपतिः । तत् अर्थम् उपयातो अहम् अयोध्याम् रघुनंदन ॥१-७३-४॥
translation: The king of Kekaya, O Indra among kings, O Joy of the Raghus, desires to see my sisters's son and on that account I went to Ayodhya.
word_meanings: रघुनन्दन O Joy of Raghus, राजेन्द्र O Indra among kings, महीपति: king of Kekaya, मम my, स्वस्रीयम् son of my sister, द्रष्टुकाम: wishing to see, तदर्थम् on that account, अहम् I, अयोध्याम् towards Ayodhya, उपयात: have gone.

text: श्रुत्वा तु अहम् अयोध्यायाम् विवाह अर्थम् तव आत्मजान् । मिथिलाम् उपयातान् तु त्वया सह महीपते ॥१-७३-५॥
translation: O King having heard in Ayodhya that you have arrived in Mithila along with your sons for their marriage I came here speedily with a desire to see my sister's son .
word_meanings: महीपते O King, तव your, आत्मजान् sons, विवाहार्थम् for their marriage, त्वया सह along with you, मिथिलाम् to Mithila, उपयातान् having arrived, अयोध्यायाम् Ayodhya, श्रुत्वा listened, अहम् I, स्वसु: sister's, सुतम् son, द्रष्टुकाम: desiring to see, त्वरया speedily, अभ्युपयात: came.

text: त्वरया अभुपयातो अहम् द्रष्टु कामः स्वसुः सुतम् । अथ राजा दशरथः प्रिय अतिथिम् उपस्थितम् ॥१-७३-६॥
दृष्ट्वा परम सत्कारैः पूजार्हम् समपूजयत् । ततः ताम् उषितो रात्रिम् सह पुत्रैः महात्मभिः ॥१-७३-७॥
प्रभाते पुनः उत्थाय कृत्वा कर्माणि तत्त्ववित् । ऋषीन् तदा पुरस्कृत्य यज्ञ वाटम् उपागमत् ॥१-७३-८॥
translation: With the night spent with his virtuous sons, he who knew his duties got up at dawn and performed his daily devotionas and reached the sacrificial place following the rishis.
word_meanings: तत: thereafter, महात्मभि: with the illustrious, पुत्रै: सह with sons, ताम् that, रात्रिम् night, उषित: having dwelt, कर्मवित् knower of duties, प्रभाते at dawn, पुन: again, उत्थाय having arisen, कर्माणि daily devotions, कृत्वा having made, तदा then, ऋषीन् rishis, पुरस्कृत्य preceded by, यज्ञवाटम् sacrificial place, उपागमत् reached.

text: युक्ते मुहूर्ते विजये सर्व आभरण भूषितैः । भ्रातृभिः सहितो रामः कृत कौतुक मंगलः ॥१-७३-९॥
translation: With the necessary auspicious rites preparatory to marriage performed at an auspicious moment, Vijaya, and keeping Vasishta and other maharshis in the forefront, Rama accompanied by his brothers adorned with ornaments of every kind came into his father's presence.
word_meanings: युक्ते at auspicious, विजये Vijaya, मुहुर्ते time, सर्वाभरणभूषितै: adorned with ornaments ,भ्रातृभि: with brothers, सहित: accompanied by, राम: Rama, कृतकौतुकमङ्गल: with all the auspicious rites preparatory to marriage having been performed, वसिष्ठम् Vasistha, अपरान् other, महर्षीनपि maharshi also, पुरत: कृत्वा keeping ahead, पितु: father's, समीपम् presence, आश्रित्य having reached, भ्रातृभि: with brother, आवृत: surrounded by, तस्थौ remained.

text: वसिष्ठम् पुरतः कृत्वा महर्षीन् अपरान् अपि । वशिष्टःओ भगवान् एत्य वैदेहम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-७३-१०॥
राजा दशरथो राजन् कृत कौतुक मन्गलैः । पुत्रैः नर वर श्रेष्ठ दातारम् अभिकांक्षते ॥१-७३-११॥
translation: Adorable Vasishta approached king Janaka and said, "O King, of Videha king Dasaratha, the best of men with his sons having performed the auspicious rites preparatory to marriage is awaiting the bestower of the brides".
word_meanings: भगवान् adorable, वसिष्ठ: Vasishta, वैदेहम् king Janaka, एत्य approaching him, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, राजन् O King, नरवर श्रेष्ठ excellent among men, राजा दशरथ: king Dasaratha, कृतकौतुकमङ्गलै: having performed all the auspicious rites preparatory to their marriage, पुत्रैः with sons, दातारम् bestower of bride, अभिकाङ्क्षते is awaiting.

text: दातृ प्रतिग्रहीतृभ्याम् सर्व अर्थाः संभवन्ति हि । स्वधर्मम् प्रतिपद्यस्व कृत्वा वैवाह्यम् उत्तमम् ॥१-७३-१२॥
translation: The giver and the receiver, indeed, attain all ends. Fulfil your own duty by performing the auspicious marriage".
word_meanings: सर्वार्था: all the ends, दातृप्रतिग्रहीतृभ्याम् through the giver and receiver, प्रभवन्ति हि takes place, उत्तमम् वैवाह्यम् excellent (auspicious) marriage, कृत्वा having performed, स्वधर्मम् own duty, प्रतिपद्यस्व fulfill.

text: इति उक्तः परम उदारो वसिष्ठेन महात्मना । प्रत्युवाच महातेजा वाक्यम् परम धर्मवित् ॥१-७३-१३॥
translation: Thus addressed by the great self Vasishta, Janaka, the exceedingly generous, highly lustrous, eminent in ethics replied.
word_meanings: महात्मना magnanimous, वसिष्ठेन by Vasishta, इति thus, उक्त: having been spoken, परमोदार: exceedingly generous, महातेजा highly lustrous, परमधर्मवित् eminent in ethics and morality, वाक्यम् words, प्रत्युवाच replied.

text: कः स्थितः प्रतिहारो मे कस्य आज्ञा संप्रतीक्ष्यते । स्व गृहे को विचारो अस्ति यथा राज्यम् इदम् तव ॥१-७३-१४॥
translation: "Did any guard prevent you? Whose command are you waiting for? Why do you hesitate to enter into your own house? This kingdom is like your kingdom".
word_meanings: मे my, प्रतिहार: guarding the door, क: who, स्थित: is waiting, कस्य whose, आज्ञा command, सम्प्रतीक्ष्यते awaiting, स्वगृहे own house, क: what, विचार: अस्ति hesitation is there, इदम् this, राज्यम् kingdom, तव यथा is like yours.

text: कृत कौतुक सर्वस्वा वेदि मूलम् उपागताः । मम कन्या मुनिश्रेष्ठ दीप्ता वह्नेः इव अर्चिषः ॥१-७३-१५॥
translation: O Best of ascetics my daughters have performed all the rites relating to marriage. They (now) stand at the foot of the altar shining like the bright flames of fire.
word_meanings: मुनिश्रेष्ठ O Best of ascetics, मम my, कन्या daughters, कृतकौतुकसर्वस्वा: having performed completely all the rites relating to marriage, दीप्ता: shining, वह्ने: fire's, अर्चिष इव like the lustre of flames, वेदिमूलम् foot of the altar, उपागता: arrived.

text: सद्यो अहम् त्वत् प्रतीक्षो अस्मि वेद्याम् अस्याम् प्रतिषितः । अविघ्नम् कुरुताम् राजा किम् अर्थम् हि विलम्ब्यते ॥१-७३-१६॥
translation: Ready at the altar, I have been awaiting you, O King Without hindrance proceed Why delay?".
word_meanings: सज्ज: kept ready, अहम् I, अस्याम् on this, वेद्याम् altar, प्रतिष्ठित: staying, त्वत्प्रतीक्ष: अस्मि awaiting you, राजा king, अविघ्नम् without hindrance, कुरुताम् let it be done, किमर्थम् why for, अवलम्बते delay.

text: तत् वाक्यम् जनकेन उक्तम् श्रुत्वा दशरथः तदा । प्रवेशयामास सुतान् सर्वान् ऋषि गणान् अपि ॥१-७३-१७॥
translation: At the words of Janaka, Dasaratha brought his sons along with the hosts of ascetics and entered the marriage pavilion.
word_meanings: तदा then, दशरथ: Dasaratha, जनकेन by Janaka, उक्तम् having been spoken, तत् those, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा having listened, सुतान् sons, सर्वान् all, ऋषिगणानपि hosts of ascetics also, प्रवेशयामास made them enter.

text: ततो राजा विदेहानाम् वशिष्ठम् इदम् अब्रवीत् । कारयस्व ऋषे सर्वान् ऋषिभिः सह धार्मिक ॥१-७३-१८॥
translation: Thereafter the king of the Videhas to Vasishta, "O Adherent of righteousness, O Lord O Maharshi perform with the rishis the marriage ceremony of Rama who causes delight to the three worlds".
word_meanings: तत: thereafter, विदेहानाम् king of Videhas, राजा king, वसिष्ठम् Vasishta, इदम् these (words), अब्रवीत् spoke, धार्मिक O Adherent of righteousness, विभो O Competent one, ऋषे O Maharshi Vasishta, ऋषिभि: सह together with rishis, लोकरामस्य delighting the worlds, रामस्य Rama's, वैवाहिकीम् relating to the marriage, क्रियाम् ceremonies, कारयस्व make them perform.

text: रामस्य लोक रामस्य क्रियाम् वैवाहिकीम् प्रभो । तथा इति उक्त्वा तु जनकम् वशिष्टःओ भगवान् ऋषिः ॥१-७३-१९॥
विश्वामित्रम् पुरस्कृत्य शतानंदम् च धार्मिकम् । प्रपा मध्ये तु विधिवत् वेदीम् कृत्वा महातपाः ॥१-७३-२०॥
translation: Venerable and renowned ascetic Vasishta said "Be it so".And with Viswamitra and virtuous Satananda in the forefront, an altar was duly improvised in the centre of the sacrificial pavilion. He adorned the altar on all sides with fragrant flowers, golden ladles, waterpots with holes filled with sprouts, earthen vessels with sprouts, holders of burning fragrant incense conchshaped vessels, sacrificial ladles, bowls filled with with water for arghya and other purposes, vessels with roasted paddy and grains of rice.
word_meanings: भगवान् venerable, महतपा: renowned ascetic, वसिष्ठ: ऋषि: rishi Vasishta, जनकम् addressing king Janaka, तथा इति "Be it so", उक्त्वा having said, विश्वामित्रम् to Visvamitra, धार्मिकम् virtuous, शतानन्दं च Satananda, पुरस्कृत्य in the forefront, प्रपामध्ये in the center of the marriage pavillion, विधिवत् in accordance with scriptures, वेदिम् altar, कृत्वा having constructed, गन्धपुष्पै: with fragrant flowers, सुवर्णपालिकाभिश्च with golden hollow plates, साङ्कुरै: with sprouts, छिद्रकुम्भैश्च water pots containing holes, अङ्कुराढ्यै: filled with sprouts, शरावैश्च earthenware vessels, सधूपकै: by burning frgrant insenses, धूपपात्रै: holders of frgrant insenses, शङ्खपात्रै: conch shaped vessels, सृवै: sacrificial ladles, सृग्भि: bowls, अर्घ्याभिपूरितै: filled with with water for Arghya and other purposes, पात्रै: with vessels, लाजपूर्णै: roasted paddy, पात्रीभि: with vessels, अभिसंस्कृतै: sanctified, अक्षतै: rice grains, ताम् that, वेदिम् altar, समन्तत on all sides, अलञ्चकार adorned.

text: अलम् चकार ताम् वेदीम् गन्ध पुष्पैः समंततः । सुवर्ण पालिकाभिः च चित्र कुम्भैः च स अंकुरैः ॥१-७३-२१॥
translation: Venerable and renowned ascetic Vasishta said "Be it so".And with Viswamitra and virtuous Satananda in the forefront, an altar was duly improvised in the centre of the sacrificial pavilion. He adorned the altar on all sides with fragrant flowers, golden ladles, waterpots with holes filled with sprouts, earthen vessels with sprouts, holders of burning fragrant incense conchshaped vessels, sacrificial ladles, bowls filled with with water for arghya and other purposes, vessels with roasted paddy and grains of rice.
word_meanings: भगवान् venerable, महतपा: renowned ascetic, वसिष्ठ: ऋषि: rishi Vasishta, जनकम् addressing king Janaka, तथा इति "Be it so", उक्त्वा having said, विश्वामित्रम् to Visvamitra, धार्मिकम् virtuous, शतानन्दं च Satananda, पुरस्कृत्य in the forefront, प्रपामध्ये in the center of the marriage pavillion, विधिवत् in accordance with scriptures, वेदिम् altar, कृत्वा having constructed, गन्धपुष्पै: with fragrant flowers, सुवर्णपालिकाभिश्च with golden hollow plates, साङ्कुरै: with sprouts, छिद्रकुम्भैश्च water pots containing holes, अङ्कुराढ्यै: filled with sprouts, शरावैश्च earthenware vessels, सधूपकै: by burning frgrant insenses, धूपपात्रै: holders of frgrant insenses, शङ्खपात्रै: conch shaped vessels, सृवै: sacrificial ladles, सृग्भि: bowls, अर्घ्याभिपूरितै: filled with with water for Arghya and other purposes, पात्रै: with vessels, लाजपूर्णै: roasted paddy, पात्रीभि: with vessels, अभिसंस्कृतै: sanctified, अक्षतै: rice grains, ताम् that, वेदिम् altar, समन्तत on all sides, अलञ्चकार adorned.

text: अंकुर आढ्यैः शरावैः च धूप पात्रैः स धूपकैः । शंख पात्रैः श्रुवैः स्रुग्भिः पात्रैः अर्घ्यादि पूजितैः ॥१-७३-२२॥
translation: Venerable and renowned ascetic Vasishta said "Be it so".And with Viswamitra and virtuous Satananda in the forefront, an altar was duly improvised in the centre of the sacrificial pavilion. He adorned the altar on all sides with fragrant flowers, golden ladles, waterpots with holes filled with sprouts, earthen vessels with sprouts, holders of burning fragrant incense conchshaped vessels, sacrificial ladles, bowls filled with with water for arghya and other purposes, vessels with roasted paddy and grains of rice.
word_meanings: भगवान् venerable, महतपा: renowned ascetic, वसिष्ठ: ऋषि: rishi Vasishta, जनकम् addressing king Janaka, तथा इति "Be it so", उक्त्वा having said, विश्वामित्रम् to Visvamitra, धार्मिकम् virtuous, शतानन्दं च Satananda, पुरस्कृत्य in the forefront, प्रपामध्ये in the center of the marriage pavillion, विधिवत् in accordance with scriptures, वेदिम् altar, कृत्वा having constructed, गन्धपुष्पै: with fragrant flowers, सुवर्णपालिकाभिश्च with golden hollow plates, साङ्कुरै: with sprouts, छिद्रकुम्भैश्च water pots containing holes, अङ्कुराढ्यै: filled with sprouts, शरावैश्च earthenware vessels, सधूपकै: by burning frgrant insenses, धूपपात्रै: holders of frgrant insenses, शङ्खपात्रै: conch shaped vessels, सृवै: sacrificial ladles, सृग्भि: bowls, अर्घ्याभिपूरितै: filled with with water for Arghya and other purposes, पात्रै: with vessels, लाजपूर्णै: roasted paddy, पात्रीभि: with vessels, अभिसंस्कृतै: sanctified, अक्षतै: rice grains, ताम् that, वेदिम् altar, समन्तत on all sides, अलञ्चकार adorned.

text: लाज पूर्णैः च पात्रीभिः रक्षितैः अपि संस्कृतैः । दर्भैः समैः समास्तीर्य विधिवत् मंत्र पुरस्कृतम् ॥१-७३-२३॥
अग्निम् आधाय तम् वेद्याम् विधि मंत्र पूर्वकम् । जुहाव अग्नौ महातेजा वशिष्ठो मुनिपुंगव ॥१-७३-२४॥
translation: Brilliant and worshipful rishi Vasishta chanted, mantras according to tradition, put the darbha grass of equal proportions around the altar, placed the fire on the altar, recited the mantras from the scriptures and offered oblations into the flame.
word_meanings: महातेजा: highly lustrous, भगवान् worshipful, वसिष्ठ: ऋषि: rishi Vasistha, समै: of equal proportions, दर्भै: Darbha grass, विधिवत् according to tradition, मन्त्रपुरस्कृतम् reciting mantra, समास्तीर्य having strewn, विधिमन्त्रपुरस्कृतम् reciting mantras according to scriptures, वेद्याम् on the altar, अग्निम् fire, आदाय having placed, अग्नौ in the fire, जुहाव offered oblations.

text: ततः सीताम् समानीय सर्व आभरण भुषिताम् । समक्षम् अग्नेः संस्थाप्य राघव अभिमुखे तदा ॥१-७३-२५॥
translation: Thereafter king Janaka brought Sita adorned with various ornaments and placed her in the presence of Agni in front of Rama, the enhancer of the joy of Kausalya. And said:
word_meanings: तत thereafter, राजा king, जनक: Janaka, सर्वाभरणभूषिताम् adorned with various ornaments, सीताम् Sita, समानीय having brought, अग्ने: समक्षम् in the presence of Agni, राघवाभिमुखे facing Rama, संस्थाप्य placing, तदा then, कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनम् enhancing the joy of Kausalya, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: अब्रवीत् जनको राजा कौसल्य आनंद वर्धनम् । इयम् सीता मम सुता सह धर्म चरी तव ॥१-७३-२६॥
प्रतीच्छ च एनाम् भद्रम् ते पाणिम् गृह्णीष्व पाणिना । पतिव्रता महभागा छाय इव अनुगता सदा ॥१-७३-२७॥
इति उक्त्वा प्राक्षिपत् राजा मंत्र पूतम् जलम् तदा । साधु साधु इति देवानाम् ऋषीणाम् वदताम् तदा ॥१-७३-२८॥
देव दुंदुभि निर्घोषः पुष्प वर्षम् महान् अभूत् । एवम् दत्त्वा सुताम् सीताम् मंत्र उदक पुरस्कृताम् ॥१-७३-२९॥
अब्रवीत् जनको राजा हर्षेण अभिपरिप्लुत । लक्ष्मण आगच्छ भद्रम् ते ऊर्मिलाम् उद्यताम् मया ॥१-७३-३०॥
प्रतीच्छ पाणिम् गृह्णीष्व मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः । तम् एवम् उक्त्वा जनको भरतम् च अभ्यभाषत ॥१-७३-३१॥
गृहाण पाणिम् माण्डव्याः पाणिना रघुनंदन । शत्रुघ्नम् च अपि धर्माअत्मा अब्रवीत् मिथिलेश्वरः ॥१-७३-३२॥
श्रुतकीर्तेः महाबाहो पाणिम् गृह्णीष्व पाणिना । सर्वे भवन्तः सौम्याः च सर्वे सुचरित व्रताः ॥१-७३-३३॥
पत्नीभिः सन्तु काकुत्स्था मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः । जनकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा पाणीन् पाणिभिः अस्पृशन् ॥१-७३-३४॥
चत्वारः ते चतसॄणाम् वसिष्ठस्य मते स्थिताः । अग्निम् प्रदक्षिणम् कृत्वा वेदिम् राजानम् एव च ॥१-७३-३५॥
ऋषीन् चैव महात्मानः सह भार्या रघु उद्वहाः । यथा उक्तेन तथा चक्रुः विवाहम् विधि पूर्वकम् ॥१-७३-३६॥
translation: The great, noble princes of the race of Raghu, accompanied by their wives circumambulated the altar of the sacred fire. King Janaka and the sages in obedience to the directions of Vasishta and in accordance with the sastras conducted the matrimonial.
word_meanings: महात्मान: magnanimous, रघुसत्तमा: greatest in the race of Raghu, सभार्या accompanied by their wives, अग्निं sacred fire, वेदिम् altar, राजानमेव च king Janaka, ऋषींश्चैव sages also, प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य having circumabulted, यथोक्तेन in obedience to the directions, विधिपूर्वकम् in accordance with the scriptures, विवाहम् marriage, चक्रु: made.

text: पुष्पवृष्टिर्महत्यासीदन्तरिक्षात्सुभास्वरा । दिव्यदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषैर्गीतवादित्रनिःस्वनैः । यद्वा -पुष्प वृष्टिः महति आसीत् अंतरिक्षात् सु भास्वरा । दिव्य दुन्दुभि निर्घोषैः गीत वादित्र निःस्वनैः ॥१-७३-३७॥
ननृतुः च अप्सरः संघा गन्धर्वाः च जगुः कलम् । विवाहे रघु मुख्यानाम् तद् अद्भुतम् अदृश्यत ॥१-७३-३८॥
ईदृशे वर्तमाने तु तूर्य उद्घुष्ट निनादिते । त्रिः अग्निम् ते परिक्रम्य ऊहुः भार्या महौजसः ॥१-७३-३९॥
अथ उपकार्याम् जग्मुः ते स दारा रघुनंदनाः । राजा अपि अनुययौ पश्यन् स ऋषि संघः स बान्धवः ॥१-७३-४०॥
अथ रात्र्याम् व्यतीतायाम् विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः । आपृष्ट्वा तौ च राजानौ जगाम उत्तर पर्वतम् ॥१-७४-१॥
translation: Night over, the great ascetic Viswamitra, profusely blessed the princes born in the race of Raghu, took leave of the two kings and set out towards the northern (Himalayas) mountains.
word_meanings: अथ afterwards, रात्र्याम् when the night, व्यतीतायाम् had passed away, स: that, महामुनि: great ascetic, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, राघवान् born in the race of Raghu, कुमारान् च princes, आशीर्भि: with blessing, पूरयित्वा having filled, तौ those two, राजानै kings, आपृष्ट्वा having taken leave of them, उत्तरपर्वतम् northern mountains, जगाम went.

text: विश्वामित्रो गते राजा वैदेहम् मिथिला अधिपम् । आपृष्ट्व इव जगाम आशु राजा दशरथः पुरीम् ॥१-७४-२॥
translation: With the departure of Viswamitra, king Dasaratha who was the source of happiness to his subjects took leave of Janaka, king of Mithila and speedily set out for the city of Ayodhya.
word_meanings: विश्वामित्रे when Visvamitra, गते had departed, अथ thereafter, राजा one who causes joy to his people, दशरथ: राजा king Dasaratha, मिथिलाधिपम् lord of Mithila, वैदेहम् king Janaka, आपृष्ट्वा taking leave of him, आशु speedily, पुरीम् to city of Ayodhya, जगाम went.

text: अथ राजा विदेहानाम् ददौ कन्या धनम् बहु । गवाम् शत सहस्राणि बहूनि मिथिलेश्वरः ॥१-७४-३॥
कंबलानाम् च मुख्यानाम् क्षौमान् कोटि अंबराणि च । हस्ति अश्व रथ पादातम् दिव्य रूपम् स्वलंकृतम् ॥१-७४-४॥
translation: The king of Mithila and father of the brides gave a hundred thousand cows, excellent woollen carpets, crores of silk garments, four divisions of elephants, horses, chariots and infantry and welldecorated, excellent male and maidservants shining in celestial beauty.
word_meanings: कन्यापिता father of brides, मिथिलेश्वर: lord of Mithila, गवाम् of cows, बहूनि several, शतसहस्राणि hundred thousands, मुख्यानाम् of excellent, कम्बलानाम् carpets, क्षौमकोट्यम्बराणि च crores of silk garments, हस्त्यश्वरथपादातम् elephants, horses, chariots and infantry, दिव्यरूपम् of celestial beauty, स्वलङ्कृतम् welldecorated, अनुत्तमम् excellent, दासीदासम् male and female servants, तासाम् for them, ददौ gave.

text: ददौ कन्या शतम् तासाम् दासी दासम् अनुत्तमम् । हिरण्यस्य सुवर्णस्य मुक्तानाम् विद्रुमस्य च ॥१-७४-५॥
ददौ राजा सुसंहृष्टः कन्या धनम् अनुत्तमम् । दत्त्वा बहु विधम् राजा समनुज्ञाप्य पार्थिवम् ॥१-७४-६॥
प्रविवेश स्व निलयम् मिथिलाम् मिथिलेश्वरः । राजा अपि अयोध्या अधिपतिः सह पुत्रैः महात्मभिः ॥१-७४-७॥
ऋषीन् सर्वान् पुरस्कृत्य जगाम स बल अनुगः । गच्छंतम् तु नरव्याघ्रम् स ऋषि संघम् स राघवम् ॥१-७४-८॥
घोराः तु पक्षिणो वाचो व्याहरन्ति समंततः । भौमाः चैव मृगाः सर्वे गच्छन्ति स्म प्रदक्षिणम् ॥१-७४-९॥
तान् दृष्ट्वा राज शार्दूलो वसिष्ठम् पर्यपृच्छत । असौम्याः पक्षिणो घोरा मृगाः च अपि प्रदक्षिणाः ॥१-७४-१०॥
किम् इदम् हृदय उत्कम्पि मनो मम विषीदति । राज्ञो दशरथस्य एतत् श्रुत्वा वाक्यम् महान् ऋषिः ॥१-७४-११॥
उवाच मधुराम् वाणीम् श्रूयताम् अस्य यत् फलम् । उपस्थितम् भयम् घोरम् दिव्यम् पक्षि मुखात् च्युतम् ॥१-७४-१२॥
मृगाः प्रशमयन्ति एते संतापः त्यज्यताम् अयम् । तेषाम् संवदताम् तत्र वायुः प्रादुर् बभूव ह ॥१-७४-१३॥
कम्पयन् मेदिनीम् सर्वाम् पातयन् च महान् द्रुमान् । तमसा संवृतः सूर्यः सर्वे न वेदिषुर् दिशः ॥१-७४-१४॥
भस्मना च आवृतम् सर्वम् सम्मूढम् इव तत् बलम् । वसिष्ठ ऋषयः च अन्ये राजा च ससुतः तदा ॥१-७४-१५॥
स संज्ञा इव तत्र आसन् सर्वम् अन्यत् विचेतनम् । तस्मिन् तमसि घोरे तु भस्म छन्न इव सा चमूः ॥१-७४-१६॥
ददर्श भीम संकाशम् जटा मण्डल धारिणम् । भार्गवम् जमदग्ने अयम् राजा राज विमर्दनम् ॥१-७४-१७॥
translation: In that dreadful darkness while the army looked as if covered with ashes, king Dasaratha encountered the repressor of kings, descendant of Bhrugu and son of Jamadagni with a terrible crown of matted hair, inaccessible like Kailasa mountain and unendurable like the fire at the time of dissolution. The laymen gazing at his blazing energy,hanging an axe on his shoulder and holding a bow in his hand which flashed like lighning and the principal arrow he looked like Siva at the time of slaying of Tripura.
word_meanings: तस्मिन् In that, घोरे fearful, तमसि darkness, भस्मच्छन्नेव looking as if covered with ashes, सा चमू: that army, भीमसङ्काशम् looking dreadful, जटामण्डलधारिणम् wearing a crown of matted hair, राजराजविमर्दिनम् decimated the king of kings, कैलासमिव like Kailasa Mountain, दुर्धर्षम् inaccessible, कालाग्निमिव like the fire at the time of dissolution, दुस्सहम् difficult to endure, तेजोभि: with energy, ज्वलन्तमिव as if blazing, पृथग्जनै: by ordinary people, दुर्निरीक्षम् incapable of being gazed upon, परशुम् axe, स्कन्धे on his shoulder, आसज्य hanging, विद्युद्गणोपमम् resembling group of lightenings, धनु: bow, शरमुख्यम् principal arrow, प्रगृह्य grasping, त्रिपुरघ्नम् slayer of Tripura, शिवं यथा like Siva, तम् that, भार्गवम् descendent of Bhrugu, जामदग्नयम् son of Jamadagni, ददर्श beheld.

text: कैलासम् इव दुर्धर्षम् काल अग्निम् इव दुःसहम् । ज्वलंतम् इव तेजोभिः दुर् निरीक्ष्यम् पृथक् जनैः ॥१-७४-१८॥
translation: In that dreadful darkness while the army looked as if covered with ashes, king Dasaratha encountered the repressor of kings, descendant of Bhrugu and son of Jamadagni with a terrible crown of matted hair, inaccessible like Kailasa mountain and unendurable like the fire at the time of dissolution. The laymen gazing at his blazing energy,hanging an axe on his shoulder and holding a bow in his hand which flashed like lighning and the principal arrow he looked like Siva at the time of slaying of Tripura.
word_meanings: तस्मिन् In that, घोरे fearful, तमसि darkness, भस्मच्छन्नेव looking as if covered with ashes, सा चमू: that army, भीमसङ्काशम् looking dreadful, जटामण्डलधारिणम् wearing a crown of matted hair, राजराजविमर्दिनम् decimated the king of kings, कैलासमिव like Kailasa Mountain, दुर्धर्षम् inaccessible, कालाग्निमिव like the fire at the time of dissolution, दुस्सहम् difficult to endure, तेजोभि: with energy, ज्वलन्तमिव as if blazing, पृथग्जनै: by ordinary people, दुर्निरीक्षम् incapable of being gazed upon, परशुम् axe, स्कन्धे on his shoulder, आसज्य hanging, विद्युद्गणोपमम् resembling group of lightenings, धनु: bow, शरमुख्यम् principal arrow, प्रगृह्य grasping, त्रिपुरघ्नम् slayer of Tripura, शिवं यथा like Siva, तम् that, भार्गवम् descendent of Bhrugu, जामदग्नयम् son of Jamadagni, ददर्श beheld.

text: स्कन्धे च आसज्य परशुम् धनुः विद्युत् गण उपमम् । प्रगृह्य शरम् उग्रम् च त्रि पुर घ्नम् यथा शिवम् ॥१-७४-१९॥
translation: In that dreadful darkness while the army looked as if covered with ashes, king Dasaratha encountered the repressor of kings, descendant of Bhrugu and son of Jamadagni with a terrible crown of matted hair, inaccessible like Kailasa mountain and unendurable like the fire at the time of dissolution. The laymen gazing at his blazing energy,hanging an axe on his shoulder and holding a bow in his hand which flashed like lighning and the principal arrow he looked like Siva at the time of slaying of Tripura.
word_meanings: तस्मिन् In that, घोरे fearful, तमसि darkness, भस्मच्छन्नेव looking as if covered with ashes, सा चमू: that army, भीमसङ्काशम् looking dreadful, जटामण्डलधारिणम् wearing a crown of matted hair, राजराजविमर्दिनम् decimated the king of kings, कैलासमिव like Kailasa Mountain, दुर्धर्षम् inaccessible, कालाग्निमिव like the fire at the time of dissolution, दुस्सहम् difficult to endure, तेजोभि: with energy, ज्वलन्तमिव as if blazing, पृथग्जनै: by ordinary people, दुर्निरीक्षम् incapable of being gazed upon, परशुम् axe, स्कन्धे on his shoulder, आसज्य hanging, विद्युद्गणोपमम् resembling group of lightenings, धनु: bow, शरमुख्यम् principal arrow, प्रगृह्य grasping, त्रिपुरघ्नम् slayer of Tripura, शिवं यथा like Siva, तम् that, भार्गवम् descendent of Bhrugu, जामदग्नयम् son of Jamadagni, ददर्श beheld.

text: तम् दृष्ट्वा भीम संकाशम् ज्वलंतम् इव पावकम् । वसिष्ठ प्रमुखा विप्रा जप होम परायणाः ॥१-७४-२०॥
translation: At the sight of the fearful appearance of Parasurama looking like flaming fire, Vasishta and all other saints who were in the habit of chanting mantras and offering oblations to the fire whispered among themselves:
word_meanings: भीमसङ्काशम् fearful appearance, ज्वलन्तम् like flaming, पावकम् इव like fire, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, जपहोमपरायणा: engaged in reciting mantras and oblations to the fire, विप्रा: brahmanas, वसिष्ठप्रमुखा: Vasishta and others, सर्वे मुनय: all saints, सङ्गता: having assembled, अथो afterwards, मिथ: mutually, सञ्जजल्पु: whispered.

text: संगता मुनयः सर्वे संजजल्पुः अथो मिथः । कच्चित् पितृ वध अमर्षी क्षत्रम् न उत्सादयिष्यति ॥१-७४-२१॥
पूर्वम् क्षत्र वधम् कृत्वा गत मन्युः गत ज्वरः । क्षत्रस्य उत्सादनम् भूयो न खलु अस्य चिकीर्षितम् ॥१-७४-२२॥
translation: Enraged at the slaughter of his father (by Kartaveeryarjuna), is he intent upon exterminating the kshatriya race? Having slaughtered the kshatriyas, in the past he was freed from anger and grief. Is he again desirous of annihilating the kshatriyas?
word_meanings: पितृवधामर्षी enraged at the slaughter of his father, क्षत्रम् kshatriya race, नोत्सादयिष्यतिकच्चित् is he not intent upon exterminating, पूर्वम् formerly, क्षत्रवधम् slaughter of kshatriyas, कृत्वा having made, गतमन्यु: freed from anger, गतज्वर: freed from grief, भूय: again, क्षत्रस्य of kshatriya race, उत्सादनम् annihilation, अस्य for him, न चिकीर्षितं खलु is not desirous of doing it indeed.

text: एवम् उक्त्वा अर्घ्यम् आदाय भार्गवम् भीम दर्शनम् । ऋषयो राम राम इति मधुरम् वाक्यम् अब्रुवन् ॥१-७४-२३॥
translation: The saints having thus talked amongst themselves, offered arghya to the son of Bhargava, of dreadful appearance and addressed him in soothing words: "O Rama O Rama".
word_meanings: ऋषय: saints, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having talked amongst themselves, अर्घ्यम् the arghya, आदाय taking, भीमदर्शनम् dreadful appearance, भार्गवम् son of Bhargava, राम राम इति "Rama, Rama" saying so, मधुरम् वच: soothing words, अब्रुवन् spoke.

text: प्रतिगृह्य तु ताम् पूजाम् ऋषि दत्ताम् प्रतापवान् । रामम् दाशरथिम् रामो जामदग्न्यो अभ्यभाषत ॥१-७४-२४॥
translation: Valiant Parasurama, son of Jamadagni, having accepted the homage offered by the saints addressed Rama, son of Dasaratha and said: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे चतुस्सप्ततितमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the seventyfourth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: प्रतापवान् valiant, जामदग्न्य: son of Jamadagni, राम: Parasurama, ऋषिदत्ताम् offered by saints, ताम् पूजाम् that homage, प्रतिगृह्य having accpted, दाशरथिं रामम् Rama, son of Dasaratha, अभ्यभाषत spoke.

text: राम दाशरथे वीर वीर्यम् ते श्रूयते अद्भुतम् । धनुषो भेदनम् चैव निखिलेन मया श्रुतम् ॥१-७५-१॥
translation: "O Rama, Rama, son of Dasaratha I have heard in full of your marvellous prowess and your feat in breaking the bow of Siva.
word_meanings: दाशरथे son of Dasaratha, राम O Rama, राम O Rama, ते your, वीर्यम् prowess, अद्भुतम् marvellous, श्रूयते is being heard, धनुष: bow's, भेदनं चैव breaking also, निखिलेन completely, मया by me, श्रुतम् heard.

text: तत् अद्भुतम् अचिंत्यम् च भेदनम् धनुषः तथा । तत् श्रुत्वा अहम् अनुप्राप्तो धनुर् गृह्य अपरम् शुभम् ॥१-७५-२॥
translation: The fact that you have broken Siva's bow is an astonishing act. It is beyond imagination. Having heard it I have come here with another auspicious bow.
word_meanings: त्वया by you, धनुष: bow's, तत् भेदनम् that breaking, अद्भुतम् astonishing, अचिन्त्यम् च unimaginable, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, अहम् I, अपरम् another, शुभम् auspicious, धनु: bow, गृह्य bringing, अनुप्राप्त: have come here.

text: तत् इदम् घोर संकाशम् जामदग्न्यम् महत् धनुः । पूरयस्व शरेण एव स्व बलम् दर्शयस्व च ॥१-७५-३॥
translation: This mighty, dreadful bow was obtained through Jamadagni. You may display your prowess by fixing on it an arrow.
word_meanings: घोरसङ्काशं appearing dreadful, जामदग्न्यम् obtained through Jamadagni, तत् that, इदम् this, महत् mighty, धनु: bow, शरेणैव with arrow, पूरयस्व fill it, स्वबलम् your own prowess, दर्शयस्व show.

text: तत् अहम् ते बलम् दृष्ट्वा धनुषो अपि अस्य पूरणे । द्वंद्व युद्धम् प्रदास्यामि वीर्य श्लाघ्यम् अहम् तव ॥१-७५-४॥
translation: O Rama after witnessing your strength in stretching and stringing this bow, I shall engage you in a duel acclaiming your prowess".
word_meanings: राघव O Rama, तत् that, अहम् I, अस्य this, धनुष: bow's, प्रपूरणे in stretching it, ते your, बलम् strength, दृष्ट्वा having seen, वीर्यश्लाघ्यस्य to you acclaimed in prowess, द्वन्द्वयुद्धं a duel combat, प्रदास्यामि shall give.

text: तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा राजा दशरथः तदा । विषण्ण वदनो दीनः प्रांजलिः वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-७५-५॥
translation: When king Dasaratha heard these words, his face fell. He humbly pleaded with him his hands folded:
word_meanings: तदा then, राजा king, दशरथ Dasaratha, तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, विषण्णवदन: with dejected face, दीन: full of sorrow, प्राञ्जलि: with joined hands, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: क्षत्र रोषात् प्रशांतः त्वम् ब्राह्मणः च महातपाः । बालानाम् मम पुत्राणाम् अभयम् दातुम् अर्हसि ॥१-७५-६॥
translation: "You are a brahmana, highly renowned and withdrawn from anger against kshatriyas. It behoves of you to give assurance of security to my sons who are young.
word_meanings: क्षत्ररोषात् from anger against kshatriyas, प्रशान्त: quietened, ब्राह्मण: brahmana, महायशा: highly renowned, बालानाम् of young boys, मम my, पुत्राणाम् sons, अभयम् assurance of security, दातुम् to give, अर्हसि behoves of you.

text: भार्गवाणाम् कुले जातः स्वाध्याय व्रत शालिनाम् । सहस्राक्षे प्रतिज्ञाय शस्त्रम् प्रक्ष्द् इप्तवान् असि ॥१-७५-७॥
translation: Born in the family of (saint) Bhrigu versed in the study of the Vedas and observance of vows. You have promised in the name of the thousandeyed Indra to renounce the arms.
word_meanings: स्वाध्यायव्रतशालिनाम् resplendent with the study of vedas and observance of vows, भार्गवाणाम् relating to Bhargavas, कुले in the race of, जात: was born, सहास्राक्षे in the name of Indra, प्रतिज्ञाय having vowed, शस्त्रं arms, निक्षिप्तवान् असि have renounced.

text: स त्वम् धर्म परो भूत्वा काश्यपाय वसुंधराम् । दत्त्वा वनम् उपागम्य महेन्द्र कृत केतनः ॥१-७५-८॥
translation: By adhering to righteousness in life and having conferred the earth upon Kasyapa, you retired to the forest and made your residence on the Mahendra mountain.
word_meanings: स: such, त्वम् you, धर्मपर: one intent on righteousness, भूत्वा by being, काश्यपाय for Kasyapa, वसुन्धराम् this earth, दत्त्वा having given, वनम् forest, उपागम्य having reached, महेन्द्रकृतकेतन: made a residence on the Mahendra mountain.

text: मम सर्व विनाशाय संप्राप्तः त्वम् महामुने । न च एकस्मिन् हते रामे सर्वे जीवामहे वयम् ॥१-७५-९॥
translation: O Great ascetic today you have arrived evidently for the total destruction of our family. If Rama is killed none of us will survive".
word_meanings: महामुने O Great ascetic, त्वम् you, मम my, सर्वविनाशाय for total destruction, सम्प्राप्त: arrived, एकस्मिन् one, रामे Rama, हते if killed, वयम् us, सर्वे all, न जीवामहे will not survive.

text: ब्रुवति एवम् दशरथे जामदग्न्यः प्रतापवान् । अनादृत्य तु तत् वाक्यम् रामम् एव अभ्यभाषत ॥१-७५-१०॥
translation: Disregarding these words of Dasaratha, the valiant son of Jamadagni said to Rama.
word_meanings: दशरथे when Dasaratha, एवम् in this way, ब्रुवति while saying, प्रतापवान् valiant, जामदग्न्य: son of Jamadagni, तद्वाक्यम् those words, अनादृत्यैव disregarding, राममेव Rama only, अभ्यभाषत addressed.

text: इमे द्वे धनुषी श्रेष्ठे दिव्ये लोक अभिपूजिते । दृढे बलवती मुख्ये सुकृते विश्वकर्मणा ॥१-७५-११॥
translation: "These two excellent celestial bows are wellknown throughout the worlds. They are stout and strong. They are the best of all, wellmade by Visvakarma.
word_meanings: इमे these, द्वे two, धनुषी bows, श्रेष्ठे excellent, दिव्ये celestial, लोकाभिविश्रुते wellknown in the worlds, दृढे stout, बलवती powerful, मुख्ये best of all, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, सुकृते are well made.

text: अनिसृष्टम् सुरैः एकम् त्र्यम्बकाय युयुत्सवे । त्रिपुर घ्नम् नरश्रेष्ठ भग्नम् काकुत्स्थ यत् त्वया ॥१-७५-१२॥
translation: O Best among men O Descendant of Kakustha one of these broken by you, was given by the gods to the threeeyed Siva, who, wishing to fight the demon Tripura with this bow, destroyed him.
word_meanings: नरश्रेष्ठ O Best among men, काकुत्स्थ Rama, यत् which, त्त्वया by you, भग्नं was broken, युयुत्सवे wishing to fight, त्र्यम्बकाय for threeeyed Siva, सुरै: by devatas, अतिसृष्टं was given, त्रिपुरघ्नम् destroyer of Tripuras, एकम् one (of the two).

text: इदम् द्वितीयम् दुर्धर्षम् विष्णोर् दत्तम् सुरोत्तमैः । तत् इदम् वैष्णवम् राम धनुः पर पुरम् जयम् ॥१-७५-१३॥
translation: This second bow which is unassailable was given by chief of the celestials to Visnu. O Rama born in the race of Kakutstha this highly radiant bow of Visnu is as strong as the bow of Siva.
word_meanings: दुर्धर्षम् unassailable, इदम् this, द्वितीयम् second bow, सुरोत्तमै: chiefs of celestials, विष्णो: for Visnu, दत्तम् given, काकुत्स्थ born in the race of Kakutsthsa, राम Rama, परमभास्वरम् highly radiant, तत् that, इदम् this, वैष्णवम् pertaining to Visnu, धनु: bow, रौद्रेण धनुषा with the bow of Rudra, समानसारम् equal to its energy.

text: समान सारम् काकुत्स्थ रौद्रेण धनुषा तु इदम् । तदा तु देवताः सर्वाः पृच्छन्ति स्म पितामहम् ॥१-७५-१४॥
शिति कण्ठस्य विष्णोः च बल अबल निरीक्षया । अभिप्रायम् तु विज्ञाय देवतानाम् पितामहः ॥१-७५-१५॥
विरोधम् जनयामास तयोः सत्यवताम् वरः । विरोधे तु महत् युद्धम् अभवत् रोम हर्षणम् ॥१-७५-१६॥
शिति कण्ठस्य विष्णोः च परस्पर जय एषिणोः । तदा तु जृम्भितम् शैवम् धनुः भीम पराक्रमम् ॥१-७५-१७॥
हुम् कारेण महादेवः स्तम्भितो अथ त्रिलोचनः । देवैः तदा समागम्य स ऋषि सन्घैः स चारणैः ॥१-७५-१८॥
याचितौ प्रशमम् तत्र जग्मतुः तौ सुर उत्तमौ । जृम्भितम् तत् धनुः दृष्ट्वा शैवम् विष्णु पराक्रमैः ॥१-७५-१९॥
अधिकम् मेनिरे विष्णुम् देवाः स ऋषि गणाः तदा । धनू रुद्रः तु संक्रुद्धो विदेहेषु महायशाः ॥१-७५-२०॥
देवरातस्य राज ऋषेः ददौ हस्ते स सायकम् । इदम् च वैष्णवम् राम धनुः पर पुरम् जयम् ॥१-७५-२१॥
ऋचीके भार्गवे प्रादात् विष्णुः स न्यासम् उत्तमम् । ऋचीकः तु महातेजाः पुत्रस्य अप्रतिकर्मणः ॥१-७५-२२॥
पितुः मम ददौ दिव्यम् जमदग्नेः महात्मनः । न्यस्त शस्त्रे पितरि मे तपो बल समन्विते ॥१-७५-२३॥
अर्जुनो विदधे मृत्युम् प्राकृताम् बुद्धिम् आस्थितः । वधम् अप्रतिरूपम् तु पितुः श्रुत्वा सु दारुणम् । क्षत्रम् उत्सादयन् रोषात् जातम् जातम् अनेकशः ॥१-७५-२४॥
पृथिवीम् च अखिलाम् प्राप्य काश्यपाय महात्मने । यज्ञस्य अन्ते तदा राम दक्षिणाम् पुण्य कर्मणे ॥१-७५-२५॥
translation: O Rama Having heard the slaying of my father incomparable in extreme ruthlessness, I decimated the Kshatriya race again and again out of fury as they were born and reborn. I conquered the entire earth. At the conclusion of the sacrifice I conferred it on the great soul Kasyapa of meritorious acts. Gifted with ascetic energy I have (now) made the Mahendra mountain my abode.
word_meanings: राम O Rama, अप्रतिरूपम् incomparable, सुदारुणम् extremely ruthless, पितु: father's, वधम् slaying, श्रुत्वा having heard, रोषात् out of fury, जातं जातम् born again and again, क्षत्रम् kshatriya race, उत्सादयन् decimating, अखिलाम् entire, पृथिवीम् earth, प्राप्य having won, यज्ञस्य sacrifice's, अन्ते at the end of, महात्मने to the magnanimous, पुण्यकर्मणे doer of meritorious acts, काश्यपाय for Kasyapa, दत्त्वा having given, तपोबलसमन्वित: endowed with ascetic energy, महेन्द्रनिलय: living on Mahendra mountain as my abode.

text: दत्त्वा महेन्द्र निलयः तपो बल समन्वितः । श्रुत्वा तु धनुषो भेदम् ततो अहम् द्रुतम् आगतः ॥१-७५-२६॥
तत् एवम् वैष्णवम् राम पितृ पैतामहम् महत् । क्षत्र धर्मम् पुरस् कृत्य गृह्णीष्व धनुर् उत्तमम् ॥१-७५-२७॥
translation: Respect the duties of a kshatriya, O Rama Take hold of this great, uncommon bow of Visnu inherited by me from my father and forefathers.
word_meanings: राम O Rama, क्षत्रधर्मम् duties of kshatriya, पुरस्कृत्य treating with respect, तत् that, इदम् this, पितृपैतामहम् being inherited from my father and forefathers, महत् eminent, उत्तमम् excellent, वैष्णवम् related to Visnu, धनु: bow, गृह्णीष्व take hold of.

text: योजयस्व धनुः श्रेष्ठे शरम् पर पुरम् जयम् । यदि शक्तः असि काकुत्स्थ द्वन्द्वम् दास्यामि ते ततः ॥१-७५-२८॥
translation: O Descendant of Kakustha this best bow is capable of conquering enemy cities. Fix an arrow. If it is possible for you to do so, then I shall engage you in a duel". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे पञ्चसप्ततितमस्सर्ग: ।। Thus ends the seventyfifth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
